brace_through_red_split.queued_line: The torn harness keeps my load mark. The tendon fibers do not relax.

event.line_2: Ride now and it reads me deep; refuse and I keep the trail cooler.

lines: I lower into the harness. It carries me slow and memorizes the edge.
Later wet locks will angle to it.
I wave it off. The head sinks.

I drive my knee into its throat ridge and shove it across the cuts. The lice leave my bootprints and gather on the blood instead.

operator_cellar.line_1: A predator has threaded its limbs into the wall-control holes and is running the old operator grip-sequence. When my boot crosses the threshold it stops and locks onto me: body flush to the wall, low, already angled for a strike.
operator_cellar.line_2: The ceiling is close enough to cut off any upward move. Three limbs are anchored in the holes; the fourth hangs free and cocked toward my face. That free limb is the strike. If I wait, it commits. If I go now, I beat it to the anchor.

probe_bones.preview: Hymn delays commitment to study the predator's anchor points and load-bearing limbs, gaining tactical information at the cost of giving the predator time to act.
lines: I hold my position and watch where its weight is. Three limbs are load-bearing inside the wall holes. The fourth is free and cocked toward my face. That is the strike limb.

It launches the free limb. I am already moving off the line. The strike hits wall tissue instead of me. Its grip pattern is exposed: it cannot reload that limb without releasing one anchor. I know where to go next.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Hymn disrupts the predator's established grip sequence, collapsing its tempo and forcing a recovery pause that opens a window for follow-through.
lines: I move toward the wall and knock the nearest anchor limb out of its hole before the sequence can complete. The predator's body shudders. It was braced for me to wait, not close.

It scrambles to reset its grip. For two full seconds it is not a predator, it is just a body trying to find purchase on a wall it no longer controls. I use those seconds. It releases the wall and drops. The room is mine.

push_through_spikes.preview: Hymn commits to forward pressure, accepting contact damage to deny the predator time to fully brace, forcing it off the wall through sheer displacement.
lines: I go forward instead of back. Its free limb catches my shoulder on the way in. The grip is strong but I am already past the angle where it can use the wall for leverage.

Without the wall it is lighter than I expected. I push it off its anchor and it hits the far side of the cellar. It does not come back. My shoulder is marked where it held. The mark is deep but the room is clear.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Hymn absorbs the predator's committed strike to bait it into a full extension, then exploits the recovery gap while it reloads.
lines: I let it hit me. The free limb lands across my forearm and the grip is immediate, tight, and pulling. I do not move back. It has committed everything to that grip and now it cannot release without losing its wall anchor too.

It holds for three seconds before the wall tissue starts to pull away from its anchor limbs. It chose the grip over the anchor. That was the wrong choice. It drops. My forearm is split along the contact line but the split is already closing. I have been in worse rooms.

retreat.preview: Hymn exits before the predator can close, ceding the cellar but avoiding contact cost. The predator remains active as a future hazard.
lines: I back through the doorway before it can commit. It does not follow past the threshold. It returns to the wall holes and resumes the grip sequence like I was never here.
The cellar is still running the lure. I will have to come back through it or find another route. The predator knows I read it. Next time it will not wait as long before striking.

It releases when it cannot shift me. I am still standing. The damage is mine to carry but the ground is mine too.

scar_map_junction.line_1: The mites finish cleaning the left seam. The middle route pulses with my own stride, already recorded. The right seam sits blank, no edge, no grain.
scar_map_junction.line_2: The floor is reading my weight. Every second I stand here, the bright route gets a cleaner copy of how I move.

follow_marked_plates.preview: Baseline pure-body route. Low cost, no mark, no recognition spike. Schedules delayed route-memory pressure when the clean route revises again.
lines: I press my palm to the mite-cleaned seam and read the grain. The plates are smooth, the direction is clear, and my weight stays off the bright route entirely.
The mites do not redirect. The junction does not log my gait. I move through without adding anything to the map, and the bright route pulses once behind me, unsatisfied.

mark_red_branch.preview: Hymn overwrites the blank seam with her own route signature. Writes her into the infrastructure. Schedules a delayed faction recognition return at a checkpoint two rooms forward.
lines: I press my thumb into the blank seam and drag it forward, opening a shallow cut that the mites immediately begin to read. The tissue takes my mark and holds it.
The junction logs my signature. The mites shift grain toward my new branch, cleaning it behind me. Something two rooms forward will know I was here before I arrive.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Hymn destroys the bright route's gait-harvest before it completes. Closes the map bargain. Raises local recognition immediately. No delayed follow-up scheduled, but a local predator may use the disruption signature.
lines: I drag my thumb across the bright seam against the grain until the pulse drops and the tissue tears. The route loses its rhythm. My gait stays mine.
The mites redirect immediately, swarming the break. The junction logs a disruption. The bright route is closed, but the floor now knows exactly where I stood and how hard I pressed.

follow_marked_plates.queued_line: A scar mite rides the back of my hand. It has been there since the junction. Its grain matches the seam I followed.

mark_red_branch.queued_line: A receipt blister on the gate post pulses when I approach. It has my mark on it. Someone read the packet before I arrived.

scar_map_junction.line_2: She says: give me the walk or I take the print anyway. The floor is reading me. I am already late.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Pure-body aggression: Hymn destroys the cord-feeder before the print completes. Costs wound-debt, raises recognition as a threat, breaks Solt's route packet.
lines: I drive my heel into the cord-feeder and drag it free. The seam tears. The mites scatter. My palm is bleeding where the anchor barb caught it.
Solt stands. She does not reach for a weapon. She looks at my hand and then at the broken feeder and she says nothing. She already knows what I am.

combat.preview: Direct confrontation: Hymn attacks Solt to clear the junction by force. Solt is a trained body, not a pushover. Winning costs health but leaves the feeder intact or destroyed depending on the fight.
lines: Solt moves first. She is faster than she looked crouched. I take a knee strike to the thigh before I get my weight under me.
I put her down but she is not broken. She pulls the cord-feeder loose as she goes and I do not get it back. She has a partial print and a reason to remember me.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Avoidance route: Hymn pays Solt's resin toll. She passes without injury but Solt's route packet gains leverage. Future rooms with Solt-adjacent factions or route-gates inherit that packet.
lines: I press the resin into Solt's palm. She nods and lifts the cord-feeder. The mites finish their pass and move off.
I walk the clean seam. Behind me the floor closes over the print. Solt already has what she wanted. I feel it in the way the junction stops reading me: it has enough.

break_marked_pattern.queued_line: A scar mite is moving along the wall seam ahead. It is carrying a cord-fragment I recognize.

The tongue-scale closes its teeth after my hand leaves. The empty pocket keeps breathing under the shelf.

One ration pocket opens and closes without loss. The scale pulse stays even after my hand leaves.

lines: I step off the scale and leave the ration pockets sealed.
The teeth fold away without closing on a count.

harvest_eggs.queued_line: The missing ration closes under the scale teeth. The count stays open.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The paid biomass moves under the shelf. A reserve pocket begins to soften.

retreat.queued_line: The ledger stays clean. The hunger does not.

event.line_2: I can take the clean open, pay light, or leave it and lose the favor.

lines: I lift the clean pocket and seal it with a thumb.
Favor spent.
I feed the teeth one notch.
Count stays even downstream.
I step off. The pocket firms and shuts.
No more discount next time.

event.line_1: The shelf reads the missing mass. One pocket seals tight; another price ridge swells.
event.line_2: Pay the surcharge, take a narrower open, or walk on and carry the count.

lines: I press until the ridge flattens.
Teeth relax one room ahead.
I pry the tighter pocket and take fast.
The count stays open in the wall.
I leave it sealed. The tooth rhythm follows.
Next shelf stays unfriendly.

harvest_eggs.preview: Immediate: ration gain. Echo: living grub count retained.
lines: I let the grub open the ration membrane and take the meat behind it.
The grub stays alive under the shelf, working its mouth around my count.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: count settled. Echo: empty grub retained.

It drops from the shelf empty. The folded membrane lies flat over the count.

retreat.preview: Immediate: no credit. Echo: closed membrane retained.
lines: I fold the ration membrane back over the grub.
The shelf seals with the food still inside.

harvest_eggs.queued_line: The credit grub keeps chewing after the shelf seals.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The fed grub drops empty. A reserve pocket softens behind it.

The sealed pocket relaxes downstream.
I tear the seal and take fast.
The grub keeps chewing my count.
I leave it sealed. The rhythm travels.
Next shelf no friend.

biomass_larder.avoidance_route: Leaving hungry is the avoidance route: no debt, no collection, no route favor, but body_drift rises now and the next room reads a hunger-thinned body
biomass_larder.recognition_effect: The tongue-scale encodes Hymn's appetite type as a route fact. The larder system, the collection feeder network, and any infrastructure that reads route memory will know whether she paid, took, or left.
biomass_larder.line_1: The scale clicks once when my weight shifts toward the meat. The teeth are folded. The pockets are open. The larder is waiting for me to declare something.
biomass_larder.line_2: I can feel the scale reading my mass. Whatever I do next, it will close on that information and send it somewhere ahead of me.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Clean transaction. Resin cost now. Route favor scheduled two rooms forward. The next larder pocket opens at payer price.
lines: I press resin into the scale's groove. The teeth close on it slowly, tasting the mass. The pocket membrane opens and I take the ration meat with both hands.
The scale clicks twice when I step back. Paid weight. The larder knows what kind of body I am today.

proceed.preview: Unpaid taking. No resin cost now. Collection feeder scheduled two rooms forward. The next larder pocket opens with teeth first.
lines: I push two fingers through the membrane and pull the ration meat out before the scale finishes reading. The teeth snap closed on empty mass. The click that follows is longer than the first one.
The larder does not stop me. It records me. I can feel the difference.

retreat.preview: No transaction. No debt. No route favor. Body_drift rises immediately. Hunger carries forward and the larder offers no pocket on the next pass.
lines: I step back off the scale. The teeth stay folded. The pockets stay sealed. The click does not come.
My stomach pulls against my spine. The larder records the absence of my weight and I carry the hunger into the next room.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: A small packet is wedged into the next junction wall, addressed in the larder's resin-stamp. It is lighter than a full ration but it has no debt on it.

proceed.queued_line: Something is moving in the wall ahead with a receipt blister pressed against the membrane. It has my weight on it.

possibility_tree: Pay: resin cost now, route favor later, next larder pocket opens at payer price
Take unpaid: no cost now, collection feeder arrives two rooms forward and opens with teeth first
Leave hungry: body_drift rises immediately, no debt, no favor, larder records refusal as route fact

corpus_influences.scenario_application: Shapes the three-choice structure: pay cleanly, take without paying, or leave hungry. Each choice is a ration decision with a forward consequence, not a puzzle. The scale's click is the expedition ledger closing.

corpus_influences.scenario_application: Prevents the room from reading as a moral trap. The scale records appetite as route fact. Unpaid taking is not punished by the room's ethics; it is collected by the route's logistics. Leaving hungry is not virtue; it is a body cost the room also records.

biomass_larder.line_2: The tongue-scale clicks once under my foot. The collector's blister arm lifts toward the shelf. She wants my palm on it before she opens anything.

buttons.label: Pay and press palm to the blister

pay_resin_toll.preview: Pure-body conduct route: pay resin, keep hands open, and buy route credit. Raises baseline_discipline and opens a later larder favor.
lines: I put my palm flat against the blister. It is warm and reads me for a long moment before the collector steps aside.
The shelf opens. The ration pockets are full. The scale teeth fold clean. Whatever the blister sent ahead, it went as a paid body.

combat.preview: Aggressive route: push the collector off the scale by force. Raises hunt_pressure and wound_debt. The blister bursts into a hostile receipt, and the collector survives to collect on it.
lines: She braces. I go through her guard low and hard, shoulder into her ribs, and she hits the wall. The shelf opens under my weight.
She does not chase. She presses the blister to the scale with her free hand before I am out the door. Whatever it sends, it goes out as a forced body.

retreat.preview: Restraint route: Hymn refuses the shelf entirely. No resin paid, no force used. Body cost is hunger. No larder favor fires, but restraint routes stay eligible.
lines: I pull my foot off the scale. The collector watches me go. The teeth fold back under the shelf lip.
The pockets stay sealed. My body carries the hunger forward. The scale records an empty weight and sends it somewhere I have not been yet.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: A folded ration pocket is wedged into the next junction wall. My palm print is pressed into the seal.

combat.queued_line: Something is following the same corridor I am. It is not the collector. It is heavier.

drowned_toll_harbor.line_2: The water rises close to my cuts. The drain vent is open under the dock ribs, and the basin already smells wet.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: biomass cost. Echo: dry dock service retained.
lines: I feed the dry mouths before I step into the fluid.
Two dock ribs lower with no splash. The black water stays below my cuts.

disturb_pool.preview: Immediate: wound recovery. Echo: bright wet marker retained.
lines: I wade through and let the black fluid close over the open cuts.
The pain drops. Bright residue dries at the wound edges.

vent_red_split.preview: Immediate: drained passage. Echo: wet route scent retained.
lines: I open the red vent under the dock ribs.
The harbor drains around my legs and leaves a strong wet scent in the empty basin.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: The paid dock ribs lower without wetting my cuts. A dry service remains in the harbor line.

disturb_pool.queued_line: The black fluid dries bright in my cuts.

vent_red_split.queued_line: The drained basin holds my wet scent after the water leaves.

event.line_2: Use the dry notch now or skip and lose it.

lines: I pass dry. The bite ridge ticks once and shuts.
Free proof spent.
I leave it. The ribs rise back to closed.
Favor lost.

drowned_toll_harbor.line_2: I can press resin to the mouths and cross dry. I can wade through and let the fluid take what it finds. Or I can back out now and lose the time it costs to find another rib.

buttons.label: Back out and find another rib

pay_resin_toll.preview: Spends resin, crosses dry, harbor logs a clean ledger entry, delayed follow-up opens a pre-cleared passage in a later room.
lines: I press resin against each mouth in turn. The lips close around it, soft and deliberate. The fluid below me goes still, current cut off, and the far dock rib rises clear of the waterline.
The crossing is dry. My cuts stay closed. Behind me the mouths seal over and the harbor settles back into its low hum.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Crosses without paying, fluid enters wound sites, contamination debt logged, delayed follow-up surfaces the absorption two rooms later as body-drift pressure.
lines: I step in. The fluid is cold and it moves immediately, pulling toward the cuts on my shins and thighs. I keep my posture tight and push forward, but I can feel it finding the open places.
I reach the far rib wet to the hip. The fluid drains off my skin but something in it does not drain. The harbor has what it wanted. I can feel it sitting in the tissue, slow and patient.

lines: I step back from the waterline. The dock mouths stay open, waiting, but I am already turning toward the dry passage behind the entry rib.
The route through the side rib is longer and the ceiling is low. I lose time but I arrive clean, cuts closed, nothing in the tissue that was not there before.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: A receipt blister has formed on my wrist where the resin left my hand. It is warm and slightly raised, like the harbor is still holding the transaction open.

brace_through_red_split.queued_line: The tissue around my shin cuts has gone tight and warm. Whatever the fluid left in me is moving now, working up toward the knee.

bone_corridor.speaker: Hymn
bone_corridor.infrastructure_actor: Marrow keeper: a dense, pale-jointed body whose palm seals the rib-screen gate. It reads stride, skin heat, and hesitation. It is not aggressive until touched or until Hymn holds still long enough for the heat lock to complete.
bone_corridor.body_path_pressure: All three routes cost something body-specific: combat costs wound margin, following the marks costs gait autonomy, breaking the pattern costs skin and resets the corridor's count. Pure-body Hymn can handle all three but cannot avoid the cost.
bone_corridor.avoidance_route: Breaking the marked pattern before the keeper can finish the stride lock disrupts the corridor's sensor loop. The keeper loses the timing window, the gate mechanism stutters, and Hymn can push through before the barbs reset. She takes a surface cut but keeps marked-lane pressure clear.
bone_corridor.recognition_effect: The corridor logs one of three identities: a fighter who cuts keepers off gates, a body whose stride is now on record, or an unread ghost who broke the sensor before it finished. Each identity changes how the next three rooms open.
bone_corridor.line_1: The keeper's palm is flat against the gate. Its free arm is loose, tracking my boot across the dust line. The barbs behind it have already turned toward my skin.
bone_corridor.line_2: If I hold still another three seconds the heat lock finishes and the gate stays sealed until I pay or bleed. The dust on the floor will hold whatever I do next.

buttons.label: Cut the keeper off the gate

combat.preview: Fighter route: Hymn attacks before the heat lock completes. She takes barb damage but the gate opens and the corridor logs a cutter.
lines: I move before the lock finishes. The keeper's free arm comes up and I go under it, driving my elbow into the joint where its palm meets the screen. It comes off the gate hard. The barbs catch my shoulder on the way through, a short line of red across the muscle, nothing that stops me.
The gate is open. The dust behind me holds the shape of a fight. Whatever reads these floors now knows I do not wait for locks to finish.

follow_marked_plates.preview: Autonomy-cost route: Hymn takes the marked plates. The gate opens cleanly. Marked-lane pressure rises for later stride gates.
lines: I set my boot on the first mark. The plate flexes and holds, reading the load. I walk the full lane at the pace the marks want, not mine. The keeper's palm lifts off the gate when I reach the last plate. It does not look at me. It does not need to.
The gate opens. My stride is on record now. The corridor knows exactly how I move when I decide to be obedient. I will find out later what it does with that.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Ghost route: Hymn breaks the marked rhythm before the lock settles. The gate stutters open. She takes a surface cut, and marked-lane pressure stays clear.
lines: I step off the marked lane before the third plate. The keeper's free arm twitches, losing the read. The gate mechanism stutters, one rib pulling back and then stopping. I push my shoulder into the gap before it resets. The barbs score my forearm, shallow, and then I am through.
No stride key. The corridor got a wound and nothing useful. The keeper is still standing at the gate behind me, palm back on the screen, waiting for the next body to be more cooperative.

amber_corridor.speaker: Hymn
amber_corridor.line_1: Amber sacs hang under the wall skin like hard blisters. Each one ties into a dark vein that tenses with the floor seams.
amber_corridor.line_2: Cutting relieves the sac and gives biomass but leaves a sweet mark. Smearing it over my skin seals edges and adds residue. Leaving keeps the pressure intact and my scent lower.

siphon_amber.preview: Immediate: biomass. Echo: sweet scent and softened seam recorded.
lines: I cut the sac at the vein knot and catch the resin before it skins.
The wall eases one notch. The air takes a sugar smell I carry on my wrist.

seal_amber_wound.preview: Immediate: shield. Echo: resin film and corruption scent retained.
lines: I smear warm resin across the split and hold still until it sets.
A thin film hardens over the cut. My glove keeps the sweetness and a faint heat.

leave_amber.preview: Immediate: no gain. Echo: pressure kept, cost: corridor attention ticks.
lines: I keep the sacs closed and move with the seam’s rhythm.
The seam stiffens one notch. I hear a dry tick travel the wall.

siphon_amber.queued_line: The sugar smell keeps to my glove. The wall holds it.

amber_corridor.speaker: Hymn
amber_corridor.line_1: The man at the plaque turns halfway. His hand stays flat on the resin lid. Bead organs click underneath, counting something. He does not speak, but his other hand opens toward me—palm up, waiting.
amber_corridor.line_2: Five biomass quiets the count and he lets me pass. If I refuse or leave, the beads finish their cycle with my pattern recorded. He will remember. The corridor will remember.

pay_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: biomass cost. Echo: quiet clicks stored as clean count.
lines: I place the biomass in his palm. He feeds it into the plaque without looking. The clicking stops. He steps aside.

skip_resin_toll.preview: Immediate: no payment. Echo: open count kept with a risk tick.
lines: I push past him. The beads finish their count. He closes his hand and nods once, slow. The amber walls pulse warmer as I leave.

leave_amber.preview: Immediate: pass without contact. Echo: partial count noise and lost quiet.
lines: I turn back. His hand stays open, patient. The beads click once more and go quiet. He closes the plaque lid and watches me go.

pay_resin_toll.queued_line: A flat line holds under the resin lid.

skip_resin_toll.queued_line: Two soft clicks keep time in the wall.

leave_amber.queued_line: That small cough does not leave the seam.

amber_corridor.speaker: Hymn
amber_corridor.infrastructure_actor: Silt, a living amber collector who enforces biological debt through plaque leverage
amber_corridor.body_path_pressure: The plaque already holds a debt from a prior pass. Silt's leverage is the plaque, not his body. Pure-body Hymn must decide whether to pay, destroy the evidence, or extract information before he can use it. Mutation and symbiote branches shift how much the record actually holds.

amber_corridor.recognition_effect: Silt learns what kind of body Hymn is willing to be under debt pressure. If she pays, he marks her as reliable and extractable. If she spoils, he marks her as dangerous and reports it. If she reads the amber first, he marks her as a reader, which is a different category of threat.
amber_corridor.line_1: He turns around before I finish my second step. His hand stays on the plaque. He says my heat is already in it, has been since the last pass, and the count is not small.
amber_corridor.line_2: The corridor is narrow. He is between me and the far exit. The plaque pulses once behind his palm, slow and deliberate, like he is letting me hear it think.

buttons.label: Pay what he says I owe
Spoil the amber before he can read it out
Read the plaque before he finishes his pitch

pay_resin_toll.preview: Hymn pays the debt in biomass. Silt seals the plaque. She leaves lighter, and the next amber pressure asks price instead of proof.
lines: I give him what he asks. He presses the plaque flat and the pulse stops. He does not thank me. He steps aside and watches me go with the particular attention of someone who expects to see me again.
The corridor smells less sweet behind me. The record is sealed. So is something else.

break_marked_pattern.preview: Hymn damages the plaque's debt layer, destroying the evidence and whatever else the amber held. Silt escalates, and the amber follow-up arrives hostile.
lines: I get my hand on the plaque before he can pull it back. The resin cracks under pressure and the sweet smell goes sharp and wrong. He steps back. His face does not change but his weight shifts to his rear foot.
The record is gone. So is anything it held about this lane. He says, quietly, that I have made myself harder to find and easier to remember.

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Hymn studies the amber directly before Silt can frame it. This costs time and requires staying close to him, but it can expose thin leverage and weaken his follow-up bargain.
lines: I put my hand on the plaque beside his. He does not stop me, which tells me something. The bead organs pulse against my palm and I read the count myself. It is real but it is not what he said. He watches me find the gap between his number and the actual record.
He says the difference is his fee for keeping it quiet. I say I know what it is now. We stand there for a moment with the corridor between us and the plaque warm under both our hands.

Read: Hymn learns the system from inside it. Silt recalibrates. The relationship is not resolved, it is complicated. This is the most dangerous outcome for both of them.
Retreat before engagement: The plaque stays active. Silt keeps the leverage and forwards it without negotiation. Hunt pressure rises without any of the information gains.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: The corridor narrows where bone spikes close rhythm. Red tips rise from floor and wall in offset beats. The Stalker clicked three seconds ago, somewhere ahead in the rows.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: I can shove through and let the spikes catch cloth and skin. I can snap enough tips to make a safe lane and leave bone dust. I can wait for the open beat and hope the Stalker hasn't already moved to cut me off.

buttons.label: Time the open beat and proceed

push_through_spikes.preview: Immediate: wound and noise. Echo: lane vibration retained.
lines: I slam shoulder-first into the closing row. Spikes rake ribs and catch my sleeve. Blood wells but I'm through.
Behind me, the Stalker clicks twice. Closer now.

break_spike_lane.preview: Immediate: lesser wound, small biomass. Echo: grit residue retained.
lines: I snap six tips with my boot heel. Bone powder falls and the lane opens.
The clicking stops. It heard that.

proceed.preview: Immediate: clean pass if timed. Echo: interval retained.
lines: I count the beat and slip through on the open interval. Clean passage.
The rows close behind me with a wet snap.

follow_up_specs.queued_line_hint: The tips I moved past still tick against each other.
Grit holds in my tread; the next floor will show it.
My legs keep the count after the lane closes.

Offer choices: stand and fight, try to outrun it to an exit, or use the environment (spike rows) to trap or slow it.

spiked_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor.line_1: The Spine Stalker is ten feet ahead, back spines flat, sweeping broken tips into neat piles. It moves with the spike rhythm, never caught between rising rows.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: It knows I'm here. Its head hasn't turned but the sweep pattern changed. If I cut in now I take it by surprise. If I slip past on the next open beat it may let me go or it may not. If I back out I lose this route. If I rattle the spikes I might scare it off or provoke it.

lines: I dive in as the row drops. My blade catches its flank before it can turn. It screams and the spines on its back snap up.
Now we fight in close quarters with the rows rising and falling around us.

run.preview: Immediate: risky slip. Echo: interval use retained.
lines: I time the beat and slip past. The Stalker's head turns but it doesn't break rhythm.
It let me pass. Or it's waiting for a better position.

retreat.preview: Immediate: lose access. Echo: sealing increases ahead.
lines: I back out step by step. The Stalker resumes its sweep, head down.
This route is its territory now.

break_spike_lane.preview: Immediate: non-lethal warning. Echo: grit trace and cooled pursuit window possible.
lines: I kick a pile of broken tips. They clatter across the floor.
The Stalker freezes, spines rising. It turns to face me fully.

follow_up_specs.queued_line_hint: Blood warms the air behind me.

Fresh hardening ridges pull the next lane shut sooner.
Chipped tips and grit mark the lane I rattled.

break_spike_lane.followup_pressure: formal predator duel with stakes and exit conditions

spiked_red_corridor.line_1: The stalker is already inside the rows, back spines flat, using the open-close beat as cover. It has not moved since I entered. It is waiting for me to pick a lane.
spiked_red_corridor.line_2: The floor row is two beats from closing. The wall row is one beat behind it. The open lane is shoulder-width and shrinking. The stalker is positioned exactly where a straight commit will bring me into its spines first.

buttons.label: Read the beat and cut across the row
Hold distance and let the interval open
Back out and lose the lane

break_marked_pattern.preview: Angle change: Hymn breaks the stalker's cover by crossing perpendicular to the row rhythm instead of following the lane. Costs a spine graze but collapses the stalker's geometry advantage.
lines: I go sideways across the row instead of down the lane. A tip catches my shoulder, shallow. The stalker's cover row closes behind me and it is suddenly on the wrong side of its own interval.
It resets. I am already inside its spacing. The duel is at contact range now, which is not where it planned to be.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Force commit: Hymn takes the straight line and accepts spine contact to close distance fast. Higher wound debt, but the stalker does not expect a body that does not flinch at the close.
lines: I go straight. The row closes on my forearm and I push through it. Two tips break against bone. The stalker reads the commitment too late and I am already past its preferred range.
It adjusts. So do I. The duel is uglier than the angle route but I am through the cover and the spacing is mine now.

proceed.preview: Patience route: Hymn waits for the full open beat before committing. Costs time and lets the stalker choose the moment, but Hymn enters the lane with maximum spacing and no wound debt.
lines: I hold. The rows open on the full beat and I move into the lane with clean spacing. The stalker expected an earlier commit and its position is half a beat behind.
I have the lane but the stalker is still between me and the exit. The duel is not over. It is just starting from a better position.

retreat.preview: Avoidance route: Hymn retreats past the first row set. The stalker does not follow. Route cost is real: the corridor's growth pattern registers the retreat and the lane will be narrower on return.
lines: I back out past the first row set. The click stops. The stalker does not follow past its interval.
The lane behind me is already tightening. The corridor registered the retreat. I will need to force more space next time through.

proceed.queued_line: A lens film on the corridor wall behind me caught the wait. Something in this organism registered a body that held still under pressure and did not flinch.

organ_chamber_red.line_2: It is not guarding the heart. It is reading me.

The chamber is mine now. The keeper's plates cool on the membrane.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Hymn
organ_chamber_red.line_1: The pulse throws heat against my chest at regular intervals. Old splash arcs on the wall match a missed off-beat at shoulder height.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: The vent ring ticks after each exhale. If I act on the wrong count, the keeper’s hook reaches me before the seam lifts.

buttons.label: Hold my breath to the ring and move on the long gap
Score one cord to drag the next beat low
Back off fast while the count is wrong

observe_organ_chamber.echo_notes: Enables one on-beat opening in a later red corridor.
lines: I count four full beats and sync the fifth with my breath.
The far seam answers on the same rhythm and lifts a finger-width longer. The vent ring taps once after I pass.

cut_heart_cords.preview: Immediate: brief vent sag; risk of room strain.
cut_heart_cords.echo_notes: Later red rooms thicken the beat cadence.
lines: I notch one black cord and let it slip three fibers before I back off.
The next beat drops low and carries more heat across the floor. The cord’s polish shows fresh scrape where I cut.

retreat.preview: Immediate: leave hot and off-rhythm.
retreat.echo_notes: Schedules a short pursuit tied to breath noise.
lines: I pull back on the wrong count and brush a plate stack. It clatters once and keeps ringing in the vent.
I lose the long exhale window in this direction and leave a noise trail the hunt can read.

retreat.queued_line: The chamber noise does not die when I clear it. A thin ring keeps time with my uneven breath.

possibility_tree: Hold my breath to the ring and move on the long gap: Hymn learns the room as apparatus before committing her body.

organ_chamber_red.speaker: Hymn
organ_chamber_red.line_1: The counting ring in the vent lip clicks once and then holds a longer gap. Warm air leaks past the lip.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: If I hold still and finish the count, the chamber will show me something. If I leave now, the gap closes behind me.

buttons.label: Hold still at the vent and finish a full count
Move on before the next surge

observe_organ_chamber.echo_notes: Refresh or confirm interval for next red room.
lines: I hold still. The ring clicks three more times, then the vent opens wider and something wet slides against the grate below.
A second heartbeat starts underneath mine. The chamber is listening back.

proceed.preview: Immediate: no extra read.
lines: I move before the next surge. The gap closes and the ring goes silent.
Whatever was underneath stays there.

organ_chamber_red.body_path_pressure: Pure-body Hymn must time the keeper's hook against the vent ring count and choose a cost before the next downbeat. Cut-capable Hymn can sever a cord to break the rhythm. Barrier symbiote absorbs the hook's first swing or the vent's heat during sync.
organ_chamber_red.avoidance_route: Retreat before the keeper's hook tilts to full extension. The seam stays sealed and the keeper remains intact, but Hymn leaves without wound_debt. A cord-wrapped receipt blister appears on the far seam two rooms out.
organ_chamber_red.recognition_effect: The keeper transmits the chamber outcome through the cord network. Two rooms downstream, the next corded organism changes its opening move by whether Hymn destroyed, synced, or refused the heart.
organ_chamber_red.line_1: The keeper's hook tilts toward me before I take another step. It has already read something in how I came through the door.
organ_chamber_red.line_2: The vent ring clicks once. The long exhale gap is coming. After that, the next downbeat hits hard enough to move my sight.

buttons.label: Drive into the keeper on the exhale gap
Plant my feet and take the beat into my chest
Back out before the hook commits

combat.preview: Pure-body combat against the keeper under pulse pressure. Timing the hook against the vent ring count. Raises hunt_pressure, opens the seam by force.
lines: I move on the long gap. The keeper's hook swings wide and I stay inside it, taking the ribs instead of the throat. The downbeat hits while we are locked together and the heat shoves us both sideways.
The keeper goes down on the third exchange. The seam opens. The cords creak and the heart keeps beating, indifferent. My ribs are bruised where the hook found the gap.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Sync route. Hymn holds the vent ring count and lets the downbeat pressure move through her body instead of fighting it. Body cost, baseline_discipline raised, keeper stands down.
lines: I stop moving and face the vent. The keeper's hook holds at half extension. The ring clicks. I breathe out and let the downbeat hit without bracing against it. The heat moves through my chest like a fist opening.
The keeper lowers the hook. The seam opens on the next exhale. My sternum aches in a way that feels like it is learning something. The cords stop creaking.

retreat.preview: Avoidance route. Hymn leaves before engagement. No wound_debt, no hunt_pressure, but the seam stays sealed and the keeper intact. A receipt blister appears on the far seam two rooms out.
lines: I step back through the door before the hook tilts past the point of no return. The keeper does not follow. The vent ring clicks once more and the long gap closes.
The seam stays shut. The heat fades behind me. I carry the count in my head but nothing else. Two rooms out, I will find out what the cords said about me leaving.

combat.queued_line: Two rooms out, a black cord running along the ceiling twitches once and goes slack. Something received the signal.

brace_through_red_split.queued_line: Two rooms out, a black cord along the ceiling pulses once in the same rhythm my sternum is still holding.

retreat.queued_line: Two rooms out, a cord-wrapped receipt blister sits on the far seam, sealed with dried pulse resin. It was not there before.

Retreat: seam sealed, keeper intact, route_memory partial, receipt blister appears two rooms out

corpus_influences.source_moment: A rooted guardian reads the protagonist's body posture and intent before any physical contact; the threshold does not open on force alone but on the quality of approach. The guardian's response changes based on what the approaching body communicates.
corpus_influences.writing_influence: The keeper does not attack on sight. It answers posture with position. Destroying, syncing, or refusing the chamber changes its first move before contact.
corpus_influences.scenario_application: The keeper's hook-tilt is the room's first pressure: it has already read something. Every choice Hymn makes is a declaration the room will remember. The follow-up two rooms later carries the keeper's read forward as a visible mark on Hymn's body or route.

corpus_influences.source_moment: A living system offers transformation through direct physical contact with a dangerous force. The cost is bodily. The benefit is real but changes what the body is. Refusal is also a choice with a cost: the threshold remembers who declined.
corpus_influences.writing_influence: The pulse vent is not just a hazard. It is an offer. Syncing with the chamber means taking the beat into the body at cost. The chamber remembers whether Hymn accepted, damaged, or refused.
corpus_influences.scenario_application: The sync choice is a body-cost path that raises baseline_discipline and leaves a physical mark the next room can read. Refusal preserves the body but leaves the chamber intact and the route partially closed. Damage opens the route by force but raises hunt_pressure.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_green_corridor.line_1: The corridor splits around a green support spine. Left branch is soft, warm—already closing around boot marks. Right is shell and cartilage, scraped clean by someone who needed tools moved fast.
split_green_corridor.line_2: The spine holds the split open. If I cut it, the corridor will fold and scream. If I step into the soft branch, the tissue will learn my stride and remember me. The wheel in the wall is listening.

buttons.label: Back away and take another route

take_green_tunnel.preview: Immediate: soft contact and slight mend. Echo: warmth print retained by corridor tissue.
lines: The soft branch closes around my boots. It's warm. It remembers the shape of my heel.

cut_green_spine.preview: Immediate: biomass yield and corridor noise. Echo: bright scrape continuity retained.
lines: The spine splits. Green fluid spills across both branches.
The corridor folds inward and makes a sound I'll hear again.

listen_at_green_split.preview: Immediate: spores settle and wheel tone maps breaths. Echo: muted-lane interest retained if repeated elsewhere.
lines: The wheel reports its breath in clicks. Someone else's steps are still settling in the soft branch.

retreat.preview: Immediate: small noise carried forward. Echo: corridor keeps a faint alarm line.
lines: I step back. The spores settle. The corridor stays split.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_green_corridor.line_1: Green spores collect in prints at both mouths. A breath line moves through the floor toward the airway wheel. The dry shell carries sound; the soft lane carries heat.
split_green_corridor.line_2: Moving carefully keeps the cloud low. Disturbing the spores cleans and stings small wounds and leaves a strong record. Muting the wheel flattens the lane’s breath for a few steps.

slip_green_spores.preview: Immediate: quieter pass. Echo: stride spacing retained by spore bed.
lines: I match my steps to the floor’s flex and keep my boots close to the ribs.
The cloud folds but does not lift. My prints set into a narrow, even lane.

disturb_green_spores.preview: Immediate: shallow sting-mend with raised attention. Echo: lifted print plume retained.
lines: I sweep my boot forward and kick the spores into a low bloom.
They sting my ankles and close two small scratches. The bloom hangs where I moved fast.

turn_baffle.preview: Immediate: lane breath flattens. Echo: diaphragm interest retained after repeated muting.
lines: I twist the airway wheel until the tone smooths and the floor stops pulsing under it.
Air goes flat for three breaths. The soft lane feels momentarily depthless.

turn_baffle.queued_line: Fine filaments lift near the wheel and hold their bend after the air goes flat.

possibility_tree: Move carefully: Hymn accepts stealthy exposure instead of open struggle.
Disturb the spores: Hymn accepts exposure for access through the green route.
Mute the airway wheel: Hymn changes the room mechanism and redirects future pressure.

split_green_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_green_corridor.line_1: Bell polyps thrum in the wall. When the breath line dips, they leak route clicks—short, long, short. Someone's teaching them a signal pattern.
split_green_corridor.line_2: If I stay still, I can count the pattern and know who's using this corridor. If I turn the wheel flat, the bells quiet but the tissue wakes—and it knows I'm hiding something.

listen_at_green_split.preview: Immediate: click pattern learned. Echo: breath map retained for later corridor sort.
lines: Short, long, short, long, short. The pattern repeats. It's a recognition code. Someone expects an answer.

turn_baffle.preview: Immediate: bells go quiet. Echo: nearby tissue notes flat-air bias.
lines: The wheel flattens. The bells go silent.
The wall tissue shivers and presses against my hand. It knows I changed something.

retreat.preview: Immediate: missed read with trace noise. Echo: light carry tick retained.
lines: I step back. The bells keep clicking. The pattern doesn't change.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: The artery on the left throbs against its skin. The right lane is all hex plates, edges sharp enough to cut through boot sole.
split_red_corridor.line_2: The artery bleeds marker when I touch it. The plates will take skin and air. I can mark this fork and come back cleaner.

open_red_artery.preview: Immediate: wet passage and scent smear. Echo: red corridors retain heat-scent.
lines: I push through the membrane. It splits and wets my sleeves to the elbow.
The corridor past the artery is slick and wide.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: shoulder scrapes and breath cost. Echo: plate seams carry my stride.
lines: The plate edges catch my ribs and thighs. Each breath costs a scrape.
I'm through, but my legs are burning and the air is thin in my chest.

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: route mark. Echo: quieter next fork of this family.
lines: I carve a notch at shoulder height, clean and permanent.
Next time I'll know which route I want before the corridor decides for me.

open_red_artery.promise: Opening the artery leaves wet evidence and draws something that follows fluid markers.
open_red_artery.followup_pressure: A fluid-sensitive organism or parasite encounters the player later, demanding payment or passage rights.
open_red_artery.generation_prompt: Create a hook event where a fluid-sensitive organism or enforcer confronts Hymn about opening the artery and leaving a fluid marker. The entity wants compensation, passage toll, or information. Tone: immediate debt collection, bodily threat.

brace_through_red_split.followup_pressure: An infection begins to set in, or a wound-drawn predator/parasite appears.

Hymn must treat the wound, negotiate with the predator, or endure worsening symptoms. Tone: bodily consequence, immediate physical stakes.

mark_red_branch.followup_pressure: A rival or territorial entity confronts Hymn about the mark, demanding removal or tribute.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: Both walls are swelling. The artery knots and sweats through its skin. The plate seams flex like ribs about to crack.
split_red_corridor.line_2: I can force through before it ruptures. Or I cut a vent and bleed the pressure myself. Or I mark this and come back when it's quiet.

rush_red_split.preview: Immediate: fast passage, skin cost, noise. Echo: danger rises in later red forks.
lines: I sprint. A plate edge catches my shoulder and the artery ruptures behind me, hot and loud.
I'm clear, but there's blood on my jacket and the corridor knows I was here.

vent_red_split.preview: Immediate: biomass smear and pressure drop. Echo: wet scent retained by artery tissue.
lines: I slice the artery below the bulge. Pressure sprays across my hands and chest, then drops to a slow pulse.
The corridor exhales. I'm soaked, but it's quiet now.

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: route mark. Echo: cleaner later split.
lines: I carve a notch at shoulder height while the walls flex and groan.
Next time I'll know to take this route when it's not about to burst.

rush_red_split.promise: The artery rupture triggers an alarm or immune response in the facility.
rush_red_split.followup_pressure: A guardian, immune cell cluster, or security presence arrives to investigate the rupture.

A guardian entity, immune cluster, or enforcer confronts Hymn about the damage. Hymn must hide, fight, or negotiate passage. Tone: immediate consequence, confrontation with authority or immune system.

vent_red_split.followup_pressure: A circulation overseer, parasite swarm, or fluid-dependent entity confronts Hymn about the loss.
vent_red_split.generation_prompt: Create a hook event where venting the artery draws the attention of a circulation overseer or fluid-dependent organism that demands recompense for the lost pressure. The entity wants labor, fluid replacement, or information. Tone: debt collection, bodily stakes, enforcer pressure.

mark_red_branch.followup_pressure: Another traveler or information broker seeks Hymn out for this timing knowledge.

The broker offers a trade, partnership, or demands the information. Tone: information economy, rival negotiation, knowledge as currency.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: The artery swells at shoulder height. A blood hunter shears loose wet and threads its jaws toward my heat. The bead line ahead shows where it has been sampling riders at this fork.
split_red_corridor.line_2: Fighting strips it for biomass and noise. Avoiding uses the artery’s sensor groove to turn its search down the wrong lane; the wall keeps that cue even after I pass.
split_red_corridor.beast_state_change: Hunter search heat can be misdirected or warmed by the player's choice.

combat.preview: Immediate: fight and noise. Echo: wet walls remember the kill heat.
lines: I meet it at the swell and cut it where the jaw hinge is soft.
Its blood runs back into the wall and warms the bead line.

proceed.preview: Immediate: no fight. Echo: hunter search vector retained in the wall.
lines: I slide off the artery side and keep my breath shallow.
The bead line holds the hunter’s turn toward my last heat.

combat.queued_line: The bead line keeps a warmer interval where I killed it.

proceed.queued_line: The wet wall keeps the hunter's angle after I leave.

split_red_corridor.speaker: Hymn
split_red_corridor.line_1: The corridor splits around a red artery. Left: wet wall weeping fluid where the vessel throbs. Right: dry hex plates with old dust in the cracks.
split_red_corridor.line_2: The artery pushes fresh beads through its skin. They'll drop soon. I can walk past or press my hand to it first.

proceed.preview: Immediate: passage. Echo: fork noted by tissue.
lines: I step through. The air changes—thin, then thick, then thin again as I pass between the wet side and the dry.
The split closes behind me. Just corridor now.

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: route mark. Echo: later red forks align sooner.
lines: I press my palm to the artery. The beads burst warm. The vessel contracts once, hard, then settles.
My handprint stays red on the skin. It'll remember me.

mark_red_branch.followup_pressure: The vessel may respond to the marked connection—offering passage or demanding more contact
mark_red_branch.generation_prompt: Player marked a corridor artery with their handprint. The vessel contracted and accepted the touch. Generate a future event where the marked artery recognizes them—it could pulse in greeting, open a sealed branch, or demand another exchange. The artery should feel like it remembers the contact and has opinions about it.

mark_red_branch.promise: Marking the artery with biological signature creates an obligation the body will collect
mark_red_branch.followup_pressure: The Inner Heart may call on the signature later—tracking the player or requiring them to honor the mark

Generate a future event where that signature creates leverage or debt—another part of the body recognizes them, something follows their chemical trail, or a bodily authority confronts them about the unauthorized mark. The pressure should feel like a bill coming due.

amar_creepstride_red_chapel.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.line_1: The chapel gives us three strides. Amar owns the middle one. His saw waits low, where my wrist has to pass if I want the seam.
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.line_2: The hunter behind me hits the corridor once. The floor rhythm stutters. Amar smiles because pressure makes students honest.

combat.preview: Immediate: close fight. Echo: the hunter hears Hymn stop running.
lines: I step inside the saw before it can bite my wrist. Too close for his full cut. Close enough for his elbow to split my cheek.
I put him into the wall on the second count. The tendon opens, but the hunter behind me hears me stop running and answer with violence.

listen_red_wall.preview: Immediate: learn the wall's opening rhythm. Follow-up: pressure test in two rooms.
lines: I keep my wrist out of his saw and set my boot where his bad foot taps. The wall answers on the third beat.
Amar does not become safer. He becomes legible. The timing stays in my wrist after the seam opens.

retreat.preview: Immediate: keep distance. Echo: Amar and hunter decide the pressure without Hymn.
lines: I give him the middle stride and drop back as the hunter strikes the corridor again.
Amar turns his saw toward the seam. For one breath he is the door. After that, his limp follows my route.

listen_red_wall.queued_line: The third beat stays in my wrist after the chapel opens. It is not a prayer. It is timing.

retreat.queued_line: Amar's limp keeps time behind the wall. The hunter keeps worse time behind him.

possibility_tree: Step inside his saw: Hymn proves close-measure violence and attracts hunter attention.
Learn when the wall opens: Hymn gains a repeatable red-corridor discipline under Amar's dangerous tutelage.
Let Amar hold the door: Hymn survives the room while letting someone else define her route pressure.
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.progression_vector: Hymn can begin learning saw timing body discipline, become recognized as a close fighter, or remain mobile at the cost of dependence and pursuit pressure.

amar_creepstride_red_chapel.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.body_path_pressure: The wall rhythm pressures timing and pain tolerance on the baseline route. Speed mutation removes the timing cost. Barrier symbiote converts the saw contact into a social opening. All routes must still resolve the hunter behind Hymn.

amar_creepstride_red_chapel.line_1: Three strides of floor. Amar owns the middle one. His saw is low, blade angled so my wrist crosses it before my hand reaches the seam.
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.line_2: The corridor behind me shudders. The hunter is close enough that I can hear its weight shift. Amar has not moved. He is waiting to see what I do with pressure.

buttons.label: Drive through his guard and end it
Let him show me the beat
Watch his feet and cross when he does

combat.preview: Kill or disable Amar. Takes the seam alone. Closes Amar's arc permanently. No followup scheduled. Wound cost from saw contact and possible hunter proximity.
lines: I step into his saw line and take the cut across my forearm. My other hand finds his throat before he can reset. The saw drops. Amar folds against the wall and does not get up.
The seam opens on the third beat. I cross it alone. The hunter hits the chapel pocket behind me and finds only blood and a dropped saw. The route is mine and the debt is nobody's.

listen_red_wall.preview: Cooperative debt branch. Amar teaches the wall rhythm. Hymn gains route_memory and baseline_discipline. Concrete debt is created and tracked. Delayed followup scheduled at 2 rooms.
lines: Amar shifts his saw to his off hand and puts two fingers on the wall. He counts the beat aloud: one, two, cross on three. I feel it through my boots before he finishes. The seam opens and we both go through.

On the other side he holds out his palm. Not a handshake. A receipt blister, small and red, pressed into my wrist before I can pull back. He says the debt is light now. He says it gets heavier if I forget.

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Resentment branch. Hymn copies Amar's timing without acknowledgment. Gains route_memory at a lower quality. Amar notices and files it as theft. Delayed followup scheduled at 2 rooms.
lines: I watch where his weight shifts before the third beat and I move when he moves. The seam takes us both. Amar lands on the other side and turns to look at me. He knows what I did. He does not say anything.
He tucks his saw and walks ahead without offering the receipt blister. The route memory is in my feet now but it came from watching him and he knows that too. The silence between us has a shape.

listen_red_wall.queued_line: The receipt blister on my wrist has gone warm. Amar is somewhere in the next passage and the warmth means he is close enough to collect.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: Amar's saw scrapes the wall ahead. He is not waiting for me. He is making sure I know he is not waiting.

possibility_tree: Kill Amar, take the seam alone, carry the wound, lose the instructor permanently
Learn under debt, gain the rhythm cleanly, carry a collectible obligation
Copy the rhythm, gain it partially, carry Amar's resentment as a future pressure
Retreat, lose the seam route, take hunter damage in the corridor
amar_creepstride_red_chapel.progression_vector: Hymn gains or steals a timed-wall read that changes how she moves through later corridors, at the cost of a wound, a debt, or an enemy's attention.

corpus_influences.source_moment: A hunter closes a corridor while a dangerous figure waits at the only exit, forcing the protagonist to commit to violence or be caught between two threats.
corpus_influences.writing_influence: The hunter behind Hymn and Amar at the seam recreate the corridor-trap structure: two threats, one narrow space, no neutral ground.
corpus_influences.scenario_application: The hunter's approach is the ticking clock. Amar's saw position is the gate. Every choice is shaped by the fact that doing nothing is the worst option.

corpus_influences.source_moment: A skilled swordsman teaches a student under conditions of mutual suspicion and unequal power, where the student must decide how much to owe the teacher and whether the debt is worth the skill.
corpus_influences.writing_influence: Amar's offer of saw-timing discipline is the teaching-under-debt structure. The debt is concrete and collectible, not abstract gratitude.
corpus_influences.scenario_application: The cooperative branch creates a real obligation Amar can call in. The resentment branch mirrors the student who watches and copies without paying, which Sabatini frames as a specific kind of betrayal that instructors remember.

corpus_influences.source_moment: The environment has a pulse that the characters can either attune to or be destroyed by. Attunement requires surrender of some autonomy. Resistance is fatal.
corpus_influences.writing_influence: The three-beat wall rhythm is not decoration. It is the room's active system. Reading it correctly is survival. Misreading it costs flesh.
corpus_influences.scenario_application: The wall rhythm is the room's body. All three branches require Hymn to interact with it differently: Amar teaches the read, Hymn steals the read, or Hymn forces through without the read and pays a wound cost.

game_opening_descent.speaker: Hymn
game_opening_descent.line_1: Chorus, I am inside. The outer membrane sealed behind me. No clean exit. The walls breathe. The slope pulls down.
game_opening_descent.line_2: Something died at the bottom. Armor cracked open, ribs exposed. Three things move in the cavity. They noticed me first.

lines: I descend toward the split armor.
The three symbiotes pause under the ribs and wait for my hand.

symbiote_host_offer.speaker: Hymn
symbiote_host_offer.line_1: Chorus, body at the foot of the slope. Armor split open. Three symbiotes are still moving under the ribs.
symbiote_host_offer.line_2: One bond is possible. The shock will kill the others and make the survivor dependent on me.

take_symbiote.preview: Immediate: one partner survives. Echo: dependency rhythm carried into later rooms.
lines: I open the ribs enough to expose the wet hinge and let one latch at the shoulder.
Two others seize and go still. The survivor waits under my skin with its own timing.

leave_symbiote.preview: Immediate: preserve body boundary. Echo: the host cavity records a solitary body.
lines: I seal the split plate and step past without touching the cage.
Heat from the floor drops on the far side of the slope. I keep my own timing and the chest stays open behind me.

take_symbiote.queued_line: The shoulder seam tightens before I ask. The symbiote has learned the shape of danger faster than I wanted.

merchant_arrival.speaker: Her
merchant_arrival.line_1: Chorus, contact. The spider-bodied merchant waits in the crossing with six hands, a scale, and a sealed egg behind him.
merchant_arrival.line_2: No reply from Chorus. His prices are already set in wet weights.

merchant_reckoning.speaker: Her
merchant_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the corridor opens into the merchant's scale room. Side paths seal behind curtains of red muscle.
merchant_reckoning.line_2: I ran from him too often. Now he wants all of me on the scale.

hunter_reckoning.speaker: Her
hunter_reckoning.line_1: Chorus, the buzzing stops behind me. The blood hunter drops into the lane ahead, blocking the only open route.
hunter_reckoning.line_2: This is the bill for all that distance.

corruption_claim.speaker: Her
corruption_claim.line_1: Chorus, my hands open without asking me. The wall tissue opens with them, matching the shape of my fingers.
corruption_claim.line_2: Too much of this place fits me. I lose the boundary.

story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.speaker: Hymn
story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.line_1: A transit cord drops beside my wrist and holds the beat I let the lock take.
story_soft_captain_pulse_mark.line_2: One nearby rib answers on that count. It will open quiet, but not wide.

lines: I hold breath through the long gap. The cord slackens when I release.
The next rib keeps a narrow quiet slip for that rhythm.
I break the count with my thumb and let the cord finish without me.
No favor owed. The next route stays wider and louder.

story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.speaker: system
story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.line_1: Chorus, a receipt blister opens in the wall and exposes one dry passage token.
story_quartermaster_lock_receipt.line_2: The token carries the ration scent I paid into the valve. Its rim is sealed and clean.

lines: I take the token. The blister seals behind my hand and the gate reads the rim clean.
The tally closes. My passage is logged and the valve goes quiet.
I leave the token. The blister reabsorbs it and the gate marks my ration debt unpaid.
The account stays open. The valve holds the scent against me.

story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.line_1: Chorus, a repair-hunter enters the corridor behind the broken rib seam.
story_hunt_forced_rib_noise.line_2: The transit tissue still ticks where I forced it. The hunter turns whenever the vibration repeats.

lines: I outpace the vibration window. The hunter commits to the last tick-point and loses my route entirely.
Debt paid in speed. The seam holds behind me.
I go still between pulses. The hunter advances past my position, reading the noise as forward movement.
The route costs me two junctions. The hunter owns the corridor I abandoned.

story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.speaker: Hymn
story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.line_1: Chorus, a small ferry-larva surfaces from a service duct beside the route.
story_soft_captain_ferry_kindness.line_2: Its harness is intact at the load knots. It rises without splashing.

lines: The harness holds. The larva carries me through the duct without a sound.
Route time cut. I owe the cradle a debt it will not remember.
I step back. The larva sinks without protest, harness still clean.
The route stays long. I stay unknown to whatever sent it.

story_hunt_weight_record.speaker: system
story_hunt_weight_record.line_1: Chorus, a tendon snare drops from the ceiling at my load spacing.
story_hunt_weight_record.line_2: The torn ferry harnesses left the same interval. The loop tightens over the place my boot should land.

lines: The loop closes on my boot. The snare reads my full load and the cradle records the weight.
I cost myself the interval. The hunt pattern has what it needed.
I land off-interval. The snare closes on empty floor and the spacing goes unconfirmed.
The hunt loses my load signature. The cradle stays blank on my stride.

story_commandant_signal_mute.speaker: Hymn
story_commandant_signal_mute.line_1: Chorus, a route packet arrives with its middle command phrase missing.
story_commandant_signal_mute.line_2: The bell polyps I muted left a clean gap in the signal. The tissue beyond it opens without a confirming pulse.

lines: The gap holds. I pass through tissue that never received the order to close.
The muted polyps cost me a confirmation. They bought me a door.
The polyps reopen. The full signal returns and the tissue seals on schedule.
The route closes clean. So does the shortcut.

story_pell_beetle_repair.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_beetle_repair.line_1: Chorus, survey mites have copied the beetle repair into a route tag.
story_pell_beetle_repair.line_2: The ridges I left intact match the copied tag. A marked seam opens along the repair line.

lines: The seam runs true. My ridge work reads as authorization and the bypass opens.
Pell's repair is my credential now. The mites logged it.
I step off the tag line. The seam closes. The mites lose the match.
No record of my passage. No passage either.

story_hunt_false_wound.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_false_wound.line_1: Chorus, the repair-hunter stops at the false wound pattern and bites the wrong seam.
story_hunt_false_wound.line_2: The blood I planted holds its jaw in the shellac. The real seam stays closed behind me.

lines: The first lie holds long enough. I clear the corridor while the hunter works its jaw against planted blood.
One bargain spent. The seam behind me stays mine.
I open a second false seam two junctions ahead. The hunter releases the first lie and commits to the new wound.
The rivalry between its instinct and my cuts buys me the full corridor. I bleed for it.

ending_soft_captain_transit.speaker: Hymn
ending_soft_captain_transit.line_1: Chorus, the lock opens before my boot reaches the pressure pad. The pulse cord starts at my wrist interval, the ferry harness lowers, and the toll valve stays shut.
ending_soft_captain_transit.line_2: No route packet names this sequence. The transit tissue runs on counts I left behind.

story_pell_survey_cuts.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_survey_cuts.line_1: Chorus, a cold survey packet opens under the marrow cuts.
story_pell_survey_cuts.line_2: The cuts I obeyed align under my boots. The open floor is rougher on both sides of the lane.

lines: I keep my boots inside the old cuts.
The marrow accepts the same stride twice. The cleaner lane narrows around it.
I scuff the nearest cut and step across its clean edge.
The survey marks no longer agree about where my next foot should land.

follow_marked_plates.queued_line: The next plates lift before I step. They already know the length of my stride.

story_silt_procedure_answer.speaker: Hymn
story_silt_procedure_answer.line_1: Chorus, a diagnostic answer opens in the operator wall.
story_silt_procedure_answer.line_2: The lens sequence is still running. The exposed tissue is wet enough to read and wet enough to sample.

lines: The answer is a pressure map—one route flagged, one sealed. I take the read. The lens sequence closes behind my eyes.
I know the cellar's next load-bearing point. That knowledge has a shelf life.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Engaged the diagnostic fully; wall registers compliance.
Pressure map read; one route opened, one confirmed sealed.

lines: I close the wall before the answer finishes. The tissue seals over wet. Whatever it held, it holds alone now.
The procedure is gone. The cellar does not offer the same read twice.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Diagnostic answer forfeited; one route remains ambiguous.
Wall procedure abandoned mid-sequence; cellar registers refusal.

story_pell_second_mark_warning.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_second_mark_warning.line_1: The next plates lift before I step. They already know the length of my stride.
story_pell_second_mark_warning.line_2: The marked line is cleaner than the floor around it. The teeth are ready too.

lines: I keep the pace the plates prepared.
The lane opens clean and leaves a second row of teeth upright behind me.
I drag my heel across the clean line and make the plate teeth disagree.
The next step is rougher, but the floor has to read me again.

story_symbiote_expectation_twitch.speaker: Hymn
story_symbiote_expectation_twitch.line_1: The shoulder seam tightens before I ask. The symbiote has already chosen where the next hit should land.
story_symbiote_expectation_twitch.line_2: Skin pulls toward its answer before my stance changes. It would work. That is the problem.

lines: I let it move first. The answer is fast and too eager.
It settles after the danger passes, but it keeps the shape of that decision.
I hold it under the skin until its rhythm falls behind mine.
The next movement is slower, but it is mine.

story_commandant_missing_checksum.speaker: Her
story_commandant_missing_checksum.line_1: A route packet arrives without a checksum. Middle phrase is blank.
story_commandant_missing_checksum.line_2: If I use it, the next split opens fast and hides one branch.

lines: I fold the blank into my route. The gap seals itself with my weight behind it.
One branch goes dark. I chose the cost.
I push the packet back into the scar. The blank stays someone else's problem.
All branches hold. Nothing is owed.

story_quartermaster_teeth_count.speaker: Her
story_quartermaster_teeth_count.line_1: A tooth-count opens under my palm. The row shows my bites and the empty breath it wants back.
story_quartermaster_teeth_count.line_2: The teeth wait with their mouths open: feed them now, or lift off and leave them gapped.

lines: I press resin in until each tooth lies flat.
The row closes and rests.
I lift away. The teeth keep their gap under my heat.
The count follows in the open row.

story_lumen_wet_marker.speaker: Hymn
story_lumen_wet_marker.line_1: Chorus, the black water dries bright in my cuts.
story_lumen_wet_marker.line_2: The healed edge is readable. Wet tissue brightens when I turn toward it.

lines: I hold my arm toward the bright edge. The tissue pulls taut and a direction locks in my shoulder joint before I decide to move.
The marker is inside me now. I know which wall is forward.
I press my sleeve against the bright edge and hold it until the light goes dark. The cut closes dull.
The marker is gone. Nothing in me knows which way the wet tissue was pointing.

story_mother_chancel_open_tools.speaker: Hymn
story_mother_chancel_open_tools.line_1: Chorus, tool rests open around the bone edit I accepted.
story_mother_chancel_open_tools.line_2: The edit fits each socket without adjustment. The rests close before I finish moving.

lines: I seat each tool and press the rests shut. The bone edit locks into the socket. The chancel seals around it.
Nothing stays open. The work is finished and the chapel knows it.
I leave the rests open. The bone edit sits unsocketed. The chancel holds the gap like a held breath.
The pattern breaks at my refusal. The tools cost nothing and pay nothing.

story_launch_authority_reply.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_authority_reply.line_1: Chorus, a launch authorization returns with my weight attached.
story_launch_authority_reply.line_2: The first packet kept its number. This one is warm under my fingers and already contracting.

lines: I close my grip around the packet. My weight registers and the bore accepts it.
The authority seals with my number inside. The bore now knows what I cost.
I sever the packet before it finishes contracting. The measure dies unrecorded.
The bore loses my weight. It will not open cleanly and the cost transfers inward.

story_pell_spoiled_lane.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_spoiled_lane.line_1: Chorus, a cold lane breaks before it reaches my boots.
story_pell_spoiled_lane.line_2: The survey field is still readable, but the lice cannot keep one path clean long enough to hold my step.

lines: I cross through the lice scatter. The field reads my weight wrong and lets me through.
Dirty passage. The survey tag on me is smeared but not gone.
I drag my boot through the lane remnant. The lice scatter and the cold path dissolves.
The survey field loses the route entirely. So do I.

story_marrow_lice_hunger.speaker: Hymn
story_marrow_lice_hunger.line_1: Chorus, marrow lice gather on the warm side of this bone seam.
story_marrow_lice_hunger.line_2: They follow the warm absence left by the ration I took. The bone around it has gone cold.

lines: I cross the cold side. The lice do not follow. The seam closes behind my heel.
The bone costs me warmth. I keep the route and the ration debt stays mine.
I press marrow scraps into the seam. The lice turn from me and feed.
The warm side clears. I spent the scraps. The hunger debt transfers to the bone.

story_silt_sample_edge.speaker: Hymn
story_silt_sample_edge.line_1: Chorus, another operator wall opens a pore at the exact edge of my sealed wound.
story_silt_sample_edge.line_2: The procedure tissue measures the fit against the clean rim in my skin.

lines: The pore locks onto my wound rim and draws a debt in amber — the seal holds, but the cellar now owns the margin.
I let it finish. The fit is exact. Something in this wall has been waiting for this wound specifically.
I press the wound shut before the pore can anchor. The rim tears slightly — a clean seal becomes a ragged one.
The wall closes without ceremony. I leave with less than I came in with.

story_operator_sealed_refusal.speaker: system
story_operator_sealed_refusal.line_1: Chorus, another cellar keeps its first two pores sealed.
story_operator_sealed_refusal.line_2: The closed pores give less information and take no sample. The third pore opens blind.

lines: I push through the third pore without the first two. The cellar takes what it gets and gives nothing back.
The procedure runs short. I finish with less than the room expected to cost me.
I crack one sealed pore. It gives me a single material read before the cellar closes it again.
One gap filled. The other sealed pore stays shut and the blind spot narrows but holds.

story_operator_false_compatibility.speaker: system
story_operator_false_compatibility.line_1: Chorus, a procedure wall opens compatibility pores for tissue I did not give it.
story_operator_false_compatibility.line_2: The false wall sample has a matching pore. Repair fluid gathers around the wrong material.

lines: I let the fluid bond to the wrong material. The repair sets fast and holds the false tissue in place.
The error closes into structure. The wall reads it as solved and stops questioning the match.
I pull the false sample out before the fluid sets. The pore closes dry and the repair aborts clean.
The wall loses its match. The compatibility pores seal over nothing and the fluid reabsorbs.

story_hunt_bright_scar.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_bright_scar.line_1: Chorus, a bright scar appears before the mites finish cleaning this junction.
story_hunt_bright_scar.line_2: The route opens fast. Its pulse already matches my stride, and the same brightness remains behind me.

lines: The scar pulls me through fast. My stride syncs and I arrive two beats early. The junction does not forget I matched it.
I am marked as a willing route now. The field will use that.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Stride matched the scar pulse; junction reads Hymn as cooperative.
Route accepted on the field's terms; Hymn's path is now partially field-directed.

lines: I cut across the scar's grain. The brightness fractures. Mites scatter from the break and do not return quickly.
The fast route is gone. I made the junction pay attention to me instead.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Scar pattern disrupted; junction loses one clean read.
Hymn refused the field's offered route; pattern broken on her terms.

story_glass_apostle_blank_route.speaker: Hymn
story_glass_apostle_blank_route.line_1: Chorus, this scar map has one blank route with no gait pulse.
story_glass_apostle_blank_route.line_2: Scar mites stop at its edge and clean around it. The blank tissue stays dull.

lines: No pulse answers. The floor holds and the silence holds. I am through before the mites register the crossing.
The blank route is behind me. It gave nothing and cost nothing—that is its own read.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Blank tissue is unvetted; risk accepted without field confirmation.
Hymn moved where the field's own cleaners would not go.

lines: I press my mark into the dull tissue. It takes the red and holds it flat—no pulse, no rejection. The blank is now mine.
The mites stop at my mark too. The junction has a new edge.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Blank tissue now carries Hymn's mark; junction gains a new readable edge.
Hymn wrote into unvetted tissue without sanction; field authority contested.

story_quartermaster_clean_payment.speaker: Her
story_quartermaster_clean_payment.line_1: A larder tongue opens one pocket without closing its teeth.
story_quartermaster_clean_payment.line_2: The pulse under it is even. It reads me as paid.

lines: I take what opens and close it with one finger.
Next harbor reads dry once.
I feed past even. The scale hums.
Prices ease once more. Claim cools.

story_merchant_hunger_open.speaker: Hymn
story_merchant_hunger_open.line_1: Chorus, a sealed ration pocket opens before I touch the scale.
story_merchant_hunger_open.line_2: The membrane is already pulled back. The open edge is wet where hunger should press it.

lines: I close my hand around the open ration. The membrane seals against my palm. The larder registers a claim it did not authorize.
Fed. The scale now shows a debt I did not negotiate.
I leave the ration open and walk away. The membrane dries at the edge. The larder loses the pocket to spoil.
No debt. No feed. The hunger stays exactly where it was.

story_larder_closed_credit.speaker: Hymn
story_larder_closed_credit.line_1: Chorus, a credit grub is sealed under its membrane and does not open when I pass.
story_larder_closed_credit.line_2: The membrane stays closed over the grub. No teeth lift from the shelf.

lines: I walk past the sealed membrane. Hunger stays mine. The grub stays the larder's.
The debt between us holds its shape.
I split the membrane. The grub tears wrong. It was not ready and now it is spent.
The shelf teeth drop. The larder records the breach.

story_harbor_paid_dock.speaker: Hymn
story_harbor_paid_dock.line_1: Chorus, a dock mouth lowers two ribs before the black fluid reaches my cuts.
story_harbor_paid_dock.line_2: The payment rim is clean. The dock ribs stay dry above my wounds.

lines: The dock ribs hold. My cuts stay dry. The harbor takes its toll from the blister on my wrist and the rim seals behind me.
I move through clean. The debt is logged and gone.
I pull back before the rim closes on me. The dock mouth rises again. My cuts stay wet.
The harbor holds its offer. I carry the open wound and the unpaid toll both.

story_harbor_drained_scent.speaker: Hymn
story_harbor_drained_scent.line_1: Chorus, this harbor basin is already low, and the mud carries my wet scent.
story_harbor_drained_scent.line_2: The drained passage is open. The route stays printed in the mud.

lines: I cross fast. The mud takes my shape and holds it. The passage on the far side is dry and open.
