My marks are behind me in the basin floor. Anyone reading this basin reads exactly where I went.
I find a seam in the basin wall and open it. Black water floods the floor and my marks dissolve in seconds.
The passage stays open. The mud is gone. Nothing in this basin remembers my direction.

story_rite_clean_sequence.speaker: Hymn
story_rite_clean_sequence.line_1: Chorus, a rite chamber has its drain cuts open in the order I used.
story_rite_clean_sequence.line_2: The cuts hold that sequence. A tool rest opens at hand height.

lines: I move through the sequence. Each cut drains in the order I set. The chamber quiets under the pattern.
The tool rest closes flush. The rite is spent and done.
I leave the cuts open in their order. The sequence holds without me. The tool rest stays at hand height for no one.
The chamber keeps the posture. I walk out of it.

story_rite_beetle_repair.speaker: Hymn
story_rite_beetle_repair.line_1: Chorus, platelet beetles seal a broken drain cut in this rite chamber.
story_rite_beetle_repair.line_2: The displaced cut will not carry fluid. The beetles close it from both ends.

lines: The beetles finish. The cut seals flush and the drain resumes carrying.
The rite chamber quiets. I leave the repair intact and owe nothing to it.
My scrape scatters the beetles. The cut reopens and fluid beads the floor.
The repair collapses. The drain mark is gone but the wound costs the chamber.

story_launch_measured_interval.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_measured_interval.line_1: Chorus, this launch bore contracts at the interval I gave the last one.
story_launch_measured_interval.line_2: The ring measure matches my recorded pause. The tissue tightens before I step in.

lines: I step into the interval. The bore contracts around me and carries me through clean.
The recorded pause resolves. The bore closes behind me and the measure is spent.
I step wrong. The bore contracts off-rhythm and the ring seals against my shoulder.
The interval collapses. The bore resets and the recorded pause is erased from it.

story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.speaker: Hymn
story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.line_1: Chorus, a red shortcut opens beside the launch rings.
story_launch_bleeding_shortcut.line_2: The wound is visible from the main route. Fluid gathers at the cut edge.

lines: I push through the cut. The edges close around me and I come out two rings ahead, wet and ahead of whatever was behind.
The shortcut costs me a layer of surface tissue. The route gain is real and the wound is mine now.
I leave the cut open and take the main route. The fluid keeps gathering at the edge behind me.
The shortcut bleeds without me. Something else will use it before the rings close it off.

ending_pell_white_route.speaker: Hymn
ending_pell_white_route.line_1: Chorus, the white lanes have stopped branching. Each cold cut gives the same safe step.
ending_pell_white_route.line_2: The survey record is complete. My next step fits the cut before I take it.

ending_operator_component.speaker: Hymn
ending_operator_component.line_1: Chorus, the procedure cellars now open before my hands reach them.
ending_operator_component.line_2: The sampled rims match my skin. Each pore opens at hand height before I reach it.

ending_opened_hunt_route.speaker: Hymn
ending_opened_hunt_route.line_1: Chorus, every scar route brightens before I choose.
ending_opened_hunt_route.line_2: The map lights a clean step before I move. Scar mites stop working and leave the bright path open.

ending_merchant_debt.speaker: Hymn
ending_merchant_debt.line_1: Chorus, the larder opens all ration pockets before I touch the scale.
ending_merchant_debt.line_2: The food is already counted against me. No trader-mouth opens. Every pocket breathes with the same open count.

ending_lumen_wet_claim.speaker: Hymn
ending_lumen_wet_claim.line_1: Chorus, the harbor fluid rises to the height of every healed cut.
ending_lumen_wet_claim.line_2: The wet organs read the healed edges and route me by the same mark.

ending_mother_chancel_tool.speaker: Hymn
ending_mother_chancel_tool.line_1: Chorus, the rite chamber opens its tool rests around my body before I kneel.
ending_mother_chancel_tool.line_2: Tool rests close on the shape already cut into me.

ending_commandant_launch.speaker: Hymn
ending_commandant_launch.line_1: Chorus, the launch rings contract on command before I enter the bore.
ending_commandant_launch.line_2: The command phrase repeats from every ring. No local pore opens to inspect me.

story_hunt_ragged_breath_pressure.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_ragged_breath_pressure.line_1: A wet rasp rides my inhale. The rib cage clicks—small cartilage teeth under my sternum—then the red rows ahead warm on my chest rise and cool slow when I breathe out.
story_hunt_ragged_breath_pressure.line_2: Boot soles answer behind me on that same ragged count against the floor plate valve.

buttons.label: Break the count with short steps
Hold a brace and slow the lungs

run.echo_notes: Pursuit weakens after the count breaks.
lines: Three short steps on the off-beat crowd the turn. The answering soles miss and smear into floor scrape.
The ragged count is broken. Pursuit loses my rhythm and pays for it in distance.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Pursuit pressure spikes briefly as Hymn breaks rhythm under active follow.
Off-beat steps dissolve the shared count; pursuer loses readable pattern.

brace_through_red_split.echo_notes: No further hunt echo from this trail.
lines: I brace both arms across my ribs and slow the lungs under the next surge. The tick loses my rhythm.
The cartilage click quiets. The echo hunt closes here without a second read.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Breath rhythm sealed off; pursuer's count anchor dissolves entirely.
Bracing the rib cage costs Hymn physical ease; cartilage strain is a real price.

story_wet_marker_dock_price.speaker: Her
story_wet_marker_dock_price.line_1: A dock mouth opens early. Air tastes like the sterile clean on my glove.
story_wet_marker_dock_price.line_2: Its bite ridge is shaped for proof, not food.

buttons.label: Hide my hand and pass wide

lines: I raise the glove. It exhales and opens one notch without taking.
Next wet reader expects this.
I keep out of its bite and pass the rim.
No proof given.

story_threads_delay_echo.speaker: Hymn
story_threads_delay_echo.line_1: In a wet stair, white threads lift toward my hand, then hesitate for one breath before they climb.
story_threads_delay_echo.line_2: Intake pores along the wall open late, as if listening for my next beat.

buttons.label: Hold my breath through the pause

lines: I keep the same rhythm. The pores follow the held beat and open on the second.
Threads part cleanly and fall behind my wrist like trained cilia.
I push through before the pores decide. Threads drag across my knuckles and snap.
The wall closes behind me. The rhythm I broke stays broken in that stair.

story_refusal_trail_echo.speaker: Hymn
story_refusal_trail_echo.line_1: A wet seam breathes a sterile odor with a blank at the center, like I skipped a breath here.
story_refusal_trail_echo.line_2: Scuffs on the rim show bodies stopping short and backing away.

buttons.label: Hold the corner and let the blank pass

lines: I wait at the turn. The odor dip slides past like cold air through a seam.
Nothing touches me, but the blank travels on with my shape inside it.
I clear the seam before the blank closes. The sterile smell clings to my collar for a corridor.
I did not let it read me. I also did not learn what it was reading for.

story_nursery_scent_orients.speaker: Hymn
story_nursery_scent_orients.line_1: Chorus, another brood lane meets me with sacs already turned. Their cilia lean toward my sleeves before I touch them.
story_nursery_scent_orients.line_2: Sweet air is heavier here. The shoulder gap is narrow, but one skin has softened where my scent matches the film.

proceed.preview: Immediate: guided slip recorded.
lines: I take the softened shoulder and the sacs brush without breaking.
The lane lets me through. My coat carries their lean forward.

story_resin_lane_echo.speaker: Hymn
story_resin_lane_echo.line_1: Resin beads stripe a shoulder-wide swath. The air bites like clean burn where someone cleared passage.
story_resin_lane_echo.line_2: The bead line carries me fast if I take the sting.

buttons.label: Set boots on the bead line

lines: The sting closes my throat and the lane burns my boots through fast.
The bead line empties behind me. Passage cost the sting and nothing more.

story_brood_learning_thin.speaker: Hymn
story_brood_learning_thin.line_1: This brood lane feels under-counted. Sacs hold still until I pass their level.
story_brood_learning_thin.line_2: Film on the floor is smooth and unmarked. Nothing here reaches first.

buttons.label: Keep my shoulders flat and go on

proceed.preview: Immediate: quiet pass continues.
lines: I pull my shoulders in and the film stays flat beneath each step.
Nothing stirs. The lane stays empty behind me.

story_hatchling_guard_delay.speaker: Hymn
story_hatchling_guard_delay.line_1: A side fold ahead shows doubled sign: small drag ridges with a fresh palm smear angled alongside.
story_hatchling_guard_delay.line_2: Breath noise comes from the fold. The guard is deeper, not at the mouth.

buttons.label: Take the fold under that sign

proceed.preview: Immediate: commitment recorded.
lines: I step into the ridges and keep my palm low along the smear.
Breath noise stops. The guard holds position and does not come forward.

story_quiet_shell_ledger.speaker: Hymn
story_quiet_shell_ledger.line_1: An opened shell hangs in shadow. Its hinge is cooled and clouded; a sealed thumb edge shows a clean close.
story_quiet_shell_ledger.line_2: Residue beads under the seal in a clear line I read by thumb pad while the hinge teeth stay cold and still.

buttons.label: Press the hinge and move on

proceed.preview: Immediate: ledger confirmed.
lines: I press the cooled hinge once and feel it hold. The seal keeps its cloud.
The shell is closed and counted. Nothing here opens again under my hand.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Shell sealed and ledgered; Hymn's presence here goes unrecorded.

story_trail_dried.speaker: Hymn
story_trail_dried.line_1: Old drag ridges lie dull across the film in a side branch. Wet shine has gone from the grooves.
story_trail_dried.line_2: The main lane is cleaner. I leave the branch to dry without my print.

proceed.preview: Immediate: trail left dull.
lines: I keep to the clean lane. The dull ridges flake under their own weight without my print.
The branch dries to nothing. That record closes without my name in it.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Side branch dries unpressed; Hymn leaves no readable mark in the dead grooves.

story_plate_lane_sets_stride.speaker: Hymn
story_plate_lane_sets_stride.line_1: Bright plates ahead sit already on my heel spacing. Each flex meets my foot without a search.
story_plate_lane_sets_stride.line_2: Dust between plates shows a single clean line. I move before they tighten.

lines: Each plate meets my foot clean. I cross before the spacing locks tighter around me.
The lane releases. I am through and the plates settle back flat.

story_hunt_blood_read.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_blood_read.line_1: Chorus, a dry warmth-smell holds in this lane. Barbs point along it like needles following heat.
story_hunt_blood_read.line_2: Red flecks on my sleeve match the stain on the ribs. Something that hunts by scent has an easy route here.

lines: I push hard down the lane before the barbs can swing back. My boots clear the last rib before anything arrives at the stain.
The lane is behind me. Whatever follows that route will find nothing but my exit.

story_tracker_narrow_read.speaker: Hymn
story_tracker_narrow_read.line_1: The next dry floor keeps my prints in one tight line. Powder pools between steps instead of over them.
story_tracker_narrow_read.line_2: A thin intake seam ahead hums as if it has been sampling this width.

lines: I move fast enough that the seam gets one pass, not two. The hum cuts out behind me.
Powder scatters under my last step. The tight line breaks. I am clear.

hunter_scent_lift.speaker: Hymn
hunter_scent_lift.line_1: The corridor ahead smells like my glove. Resin sweetness hangs under the seam and holds my wrist print.
hunter_scent_lift.line_2: A scrape at nose height matches where I brushed the wall.

red_corridor_noise_variant.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_variant.line_1: The next red seam repeats a dry tick in the wall and a thin patch where resin set fast.
red_corridor_noise_variant.line_2: When I brush it, film tacks to my glove and lets go. The tick keeps its interval in the bone.

red_corridor_noise_variant_dry.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_variant_dry.line_1: A bare red seam ahead keeps the same dry tick with no film. The sound walks the joint like a metronome.
red_corridor_noise_variant_dry.line_2: Stored pressure, not leak. My steps add a second, softer click until I stop.

buttons.label: Match the dry tick and move

red_corridor_noise_variant_partial.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_variant_partial.line_1: A resin plaque ahead closes on a cough. The beads under its lid never finished their line.
red_corridor_noise_variant_partial.line_2: That half-click rides the seam like a flaw in the rhythm.

ledger_repeat_echo.speaker: Hymn
ledger_repeat_echo.line_1: A toll mouth opens downstream with its beads already aligned. The pattern under the lid matches what I left.
ledger_repeat_echo.line_2: Clean payment holds a flat line. Two soft ticks linger after close.

ledger_repeat_echo_open.speaker: Hymn
ledger_repeat_echo_open.line_1: Another toll plate warms at my approach. Inside the resin, two soft ticks answer in my pace.
ledger_repeat_echo_open.line_2: I walk past and let it close on my count.

red_corridor_noise_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_noise_echo.line_1: Two opposing red rows kiss at their tips and hum. The pitch matches the lane I left.
red_corridor_noise_echo.line_2: Two rows ahead tick together once, louder than the rest. The teeth hold a thin seam that presses my sleeve if I shoulder; the count leaves a narrow quiet slip if I keep it.

buttons.label: Keep the count and pass quiet
Shoulder a gap through the hum
Back off and let the rows settle

lines: I hold the count and slip between the rows. The hum stays steady.
The seam closes behind me without a catch. The corridor opens quiet ahead.

red_corridor_grit_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_grit_echo.line_1: Red grit clings in my tread and sits in floor cuts ahead. Chipped tips line to the lane I kicked.
red_corridor_grit_echo.line_2: Whatever I do next prints here.

buttons.label: Step back into my broken line
Kick fresh chips and widen it
Withdraw and leave the trace short

lines: I step back into my own broken line. The grit fits my tread.
The chips settle beneath me. The corridor stops watching.

red_corridor_timing_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_timing_echo.line_1: Open beats land in the rhythm my legs kept. One window holds a breath longer.
red_corridor_timing_echo.line_2: The front teeth pause with a visible gap. Matching that pause gives me a clean shoulder pass; breaking it with a shove will scrape; standing off lets the teeth finish the close.

buttons.label: Match the long window and go
Break the count with a hard shove
Stand off and lose the rhythm

lines: I match the long window and shoulder through clean. The teeth pause as I pass.
The gap closes behind me on rhythm. The corridor accepts the timing and lets me through.

red_corridor_predator_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_predator_echo.line_1: Copper-sour air ahead. Floor rows carry a dragged scent between tips.
red_corridor_predator_echo.line_2: A lane reader hunts close. Cut forward now, slip on the open, or fall back.

buttons.label: Cut forward before it fixes me
Fall back and let the scent drift

red_corridor_offtime_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_offtime_echo.line_1: A rear row clicks off-time once, then corrects. The ambush missed a catch.
red_corridor_offtime_echo.line_2: One tooth lags and shows a thin wet notch. Moving on that notch slips me through; jamming the notch will teach the teeth harder; holding here lets the row reset tight.

buttons.label: Jam the flaw open with a shove
Hold position until the count resets

red_corridor_fast_close_echo.speaker: Hymn
red_corridor_fast_close_echo.line_1: Fresh hardening ridges sit on the next rows. They close one notch sooner than the count suggests.
red_corridor_fast_close_echo.line_2: The teeth bite early on my knee line. If I rush I catch the slim open; if I force, the ridges take shoulder skin; if I back out, the lane is lost.

buttons.label: Force a gap through the new ridges
Back out from the fast close

story_smother_flat_air_warning.speaker: Hymn
story_smother_flat_air_warning.line_1: A later corridor answers the flat-air habit. Diaphragm tissue ahead is smooth and underfilled. Filament hairs lean into the stillness like grass after a held breath.
story_smother_flat_air_warning.line_2: When I test a step, the membrane closes a narrow window, then waits for the same flat interval I set at the wheel.

buttons.label: Back away and reset my pace

proceed.preview: Immediate: timed pass. Echo: flat-air bias recorded again.
lines: I match the pause and walk through on the low of the breath.
The window closes behind my heel and keeps the same held interval.

retreat.preview: Immediate: avoided squeeze. Echo: diaphragm keeps its pause without me.
lines: I step back before the tissue takes my timing.
The membrane holds the pause like a habit looking for a body.

story_hunt_kill_heat_trace.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_kill_heat_trace.line_1: Red wall beads ahead run warmer in one short interval. The heat band matches the jaw height I cut before.
story_hunt_kill_heat_trace.line_2: The corridor opens easier along that warm stripe. I ride it through before the pulse closes.

proceed.preview: Immediate: corridor yields. Prior cut opened this lane.
lines: The warm band parts around my shoulder and the wall gives without resistance.
My last cut made this passage; the body remembered the blade.

story_hunt_scent_tracking.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_scent_tracking.line_1: Wet tissue ahead turns toward my last heat. A hunter groove opens shallow in the wall.
story_hunt_scent_tracking.line_2: Cross quiet and give it little, or run the dry edge and trade scent for noise.

proceed.preview: Immediate: low exposure. Groove stays shallow, tissue settles.
lines: I keep my shoulders narrow and the groove barely registers my crossing.
The wet wall folds back without locking; I gave it nothing to hold.

run.preview: Immediate: fast clear. Noise spike wakes the groove behind me.
lines: I hit the dry edge hard and the groove snaps open at my back.
I am through before it closes, but the corridor heard every step.

story_lathe_recognizes_touch.speaker: Hymn
story_lathe_recognizes_touch.line_1: Another ridge-cutter thins its bite when my hand shadow crosses the eye pore.
story_lathe_recognizes_touch.line_2: Fresh curls gather under the lip. It is holding my touch profile from the other lane.

lines: The blade stays thin the whole pass. I am through before it resets to full bite.
Curls fall behind me. The eye pore closes. The lane is done with me.

story_guard_drawn_to_jag.speaker: Hymn
story_guard_drawn_to_jag.line_1: A later ridge shows a torn shave with my wedge angle in it.
story_guard_drawn_to_jag.line_2: A hanging guard has already dropped to watch that jag.

lines: I pull wide of the jag and keep my shoulder to the far wall. The guard's eye stays on the torn ridge.
It never turns. My cut stays behind me like bait I left on purpose.

story_lathe_rhythm_recall.speaker: Hymn
story_lathe_rhythm_recall.line_1: Teeth scrape in the wall on the same shallow interval I counted before.
story_lathe_rhythm_recall.line_2: The safe step still fits between two thin cuts.

lines: I land the step in the gap. The teeth close behind my heel, not on it. The interval holds.
My count was right. I am through without a nick.

story_hunt_cache_blood_scent.speaker: Hymn
story_hunt_cache_blood_scent.line_1: The cache lane ahead smells like warm tissue and dry marrow floss.
story_hunt_cache_blood_scent.line_2: Fibers on my sleeve match the guard's residue. Hunters read this kind of thread as a route.

lines: I clear the lane before the fiber-read closes. No pursuit locks behind me.
The cache smell drops off fast. I am past the window.

story_pell_cache_note.speaker: Hymn
story_pell_cache_note.line_1: A rib screen farther on has dust settled in my boot width.
story_pell_cache_note.line_2: Whoever reads caches will know I left that one closed.

proceed.preview: Immediate: cache left sealed as deliberate record.
lines: I step past without disturbing the dust. The boot-width print stays as my only statement.
Cache closed. The rib screen holds that silence as a cost I chose to pay.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Cache contents forfeited; Hymn pays the cost of leaving it sealed.
Boot-width dust print left as legible record for any reader who follows.

amber_sweet_record.speaker: Hymn
amber_sweet_record.line_1: A later seam carries the same sugar on the air. Wall skin is soft where a sac was eased.
amber_sweet_record.line_2: My glove mark sits in the tack, neat enough for a nose to follow.

lines: I move forward and leave the mark in the tack. The sugar clings to my glove into the next seam.
I am a corridor ahead of whatever finds that spot. The tack is behind me now.

plate_snare_warning_v1.speaker: Her
plate_snare_warning_v1.line_1: Plates ahead sit on my stride already. Fine teeth show in the seams.
plate_snare_warning_v1.line_2: Break it now and they forget. Keep it and they set a mouth for me one room ahead.

lines: I step wide and grind the glow dull.
The lane loses my count.
I keep heel-to-toe. Teeth align for me downstream.
Snare scheduled.

healing_instability_probe_v1.speaker: Her
healing_instability_probe_v1.line_1: Clean rims at my cuts shine. One edge stays dry and sharp against the wet.
healing_instability_probe_v1.line_2: If I show that edge, a reader will take it. If I cover it, the drag keeps on me.

lines: I raise the rim. The reader bites once and goes still.
The trail brightens in my wake.
I keep it under skin and cloth.
The pull stays on me.

amar_creepstride_pinch_gate.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_pinch_gate.line_1: Two rooms later the corridor narrows to one red seam. The wall opens on the same third beat, but faster. Amar comes out of a side duct with his saw already wet.
amar_creepstride_pinch_gate.line_2: The hunter is close enough that the seam flexes toward its breath. If I cut late, the wall keeps my arm. If I cut early, Amar gets the opening.

buttons.label: Brace and take the line alone

mark_red_branch.preview: Immediate: clean passage with learned timing. Echo: wall timing advances.
lines: I cut when his bad foot lands. The tendon opens under my wrist instead of against it.
Amar passes after me, not before me. That matters. I know the opening now, even if the saw is still his.
result_lines: I slip through on his count. The seam closes behind us both — a shared debt neither of us named.
The hunter loses the gap. I gained the beat. Amar owes me nothing and I owe him the same.

brace_through_red_split.preview: Immediate: solo breakthrough. Echo: wrist strain invites body adaptation.
lines: I set my shoulder in the seam and take the tendon on my wrist guard.
The passage opens ugly. A hot line crawls under my forearm, shaped almost like a future spur.
result_lines: I force the seam alone. My forearm pays the toll — a bright line of injury that will not close clean.
Amar watches me bleed through. He does not help. The route is mine but the cost is already compounding.

combat.preview: Immediate: kill Amar under pressure. Echo: the hunter learns the timing.
lines: I let him make the opening and put my blade through him as the seam starts to relax.
His saw falls on the third beat. The hunter behind us learns the timing before I clear the gap.
result_lines: Amar drops. The seam opens on his blood and I cross it. The bargain was his life for my route.
The hunter behind me reads the kill and the timing both. I bought passage and sold the corridor in the same cut.

amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.line_1: The next chamber is a lung with ribs too close for a full swing. Warm bags swell from the wall. Each breath pulls hunter scent through the side duct.
amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.line_2: Amar kneels because the floor hooks his shins on purpose. He puts the saw across two cords and waits for me to choose the count or the bite.

buttons.label: Leave Amar in the narrow space

observe_organ_chamber.preview: Immediate: learn breath timing. Follow-up: controlled escape.
lines: I keep the saw, cords, and side duct in one line until the lung shows its slow breath.
The hunter route opens only on the downbeat. I leave with its breathing rhythm under my ribs.

cut_heart_cords.preview: Immediate: shared cut misdirects pursuit. Echo: debt to Amar and saw timing both rise.
lines: We cut opposite cords on the same beat. His saw binds. My blade finishes the line before the lung can inhale.
Cold red air pours across us and takes our scent sideways. For one room the hunter follows the wrong breath.

retreat.preview: Immediate: escape by sacrifice. Echo: debt to Amar follows the route.
lines: I step out of the narrow gap and let the lung pull him into it.
The hunter bites where Amar has to be. The route opens, but the saw keeps knocking inside the wall after I pass.

observe_organ_chamber.queued_line: The lung rhythm stays under my ribs. The next red seam breathes before it moves.

cut_heart_cords.queued_line: Cold red air follows the cord-cut. The hunter takes the false route first.

possibility_tree: Watch the lung breathe: Hymn gains route timing and keeps the fight controlled.
Cut opposite cords with Amar: Hymn accepts shared technique and pursuit misdirection.
Leave Amar in the narrow space: Hymn survives through sacrifice and deepens debt to Amar pressure.
amar_creepstride_chapel_lung.progression_vector: This beat converts the wall timing from seam-reading into breath-reading under pursuit, or turns Amar into the cost of passage.

amar_creepstride_last_stride.speaker: Hymn
amar_creepstride_last_stride.line_1: Final pinch. The seam closes too fast for Amar's limp and too narrow for my old stance. The hunter comes in low, nose first, where the wall has learned our timing.
amar_creepstride_last_stride.line_2: I set my wrist on the third beat. The tendon opens before the bite lands. Amar sees me do it without his saw and lowers his head once.
possibility_tree: Wake with the wall timing: Hymn carries a red-corridor stance into future runs.
If the chain was broken earlier, this ending pressure diverts into hunter noise, mutation appetite, or debt to Amar instead.
amar_creepstride_last_stride.progression_vector: The scenario pays out as learned martial anatomy: a route-reading wrist discipline that can later become stance, reputation, or mutation.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Hunter's approach vector was broken by Hymn's self-cut; the corridor threat is resolved and does not carry into the next run.
Amar witnessed Hymn act without the saw and acknowledged it. Relationship state advances from observed-ally to mutual-recognition.
Wall timing is now internalized as wrist discipline; Hymn carries a functional red-corridor stance into future runs.

lines: The third-beat cut is yours now. Your wrist knows the seam before your eyes do.
Amar's lowered head meant: you passed without his tools. He will not forget that.
The hunter's corridor is spent. That pressure does not follow you forward.

story_white_marrow_cold_step.speaker: system
story_white_marrow_cold_step.line_1: Another marrow floor clicks under me. Lice wait inside the clean cuts, leaving pale cold edges beside warmer flats.
story_white_marrow_cold_step.line_2: My foot finds the cold edge before the lane can take a full print. The marked floor waits for the rest of my weight.

lines: I touch the cold edge first and lift before warmth settles. The lane loses the full shape of my stride.
I leave the cut floor before it finishes reading me. The trick stays partial, but so does the field's record.

story_white_marrow_dirty_lane.speaker: Hymn
story_white_marrow_dirty_lane.line_1: The next survey cuts are dirty before I reach them. Lice drag marrow dust from one lane into another.
story_white_marrow_dirty_lane.line_2: The cleanest cut is only half clean. It gives a route and asks for a fresh mark in the same motion.

lines: Dust coats my boots. The route holds but I carry contamination forward—the field registers my passage as a new smear.
I am through. The lane is dirtier for it.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Crossed contaminated cuts without clearing; survey integrity degrades.
Route taken without delay.

lines: One clean line costs me skin off two knuckles. The field accepts the mark. The route is honest now.
I paid for clarity. The lane remembers the price.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: One lane restored to clean read; survey integrity recovers partially.
Physical scrape; minor wound registered.

story_white_marrow_blood_hound.speaker: Hymn
story_white_marrow_blood_hound.line_1: A hound shape pauses at the far end of the next cold lane. It lowers its nose to an old red scrape in the white floor.
story_white_marrow_blood_hound.line_2: It has my blood direction, not my stride. Its head is still down, but the hallway is short.

lines: I move while its nose is still on the scrape. The first bite closes on old blood instead of my ankle.
The lane is clear. The hound's adaptation resets behind me, slower now.
I strike while its head is low. The lane gives me one clean hit and takes another red mark in payment.
The hound is down but the debt is open. A second predator adapts to the fresh wound signal.

operator_cellar_grip_predator_reload_win.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar_grip_predator_reload_win.line_1: Two rooms later, another wall body holds low above a corridor bend. Three limbs are sunk into tool holes. The fourth hangs loose and ready.
operator_cellar_grip_predator_reload_win.line_2: It has not seen me. When that free limb fires, its wall grip will weaken.

lines: I move into the gap before the free limb reloads. One strike. The organism does not recover its grip.
The corridor is clear. I can read grip-anchor bodies now.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Grip-anchor organism eliminated; corridor cleared.
Reload window exploited successfully; pattern confirmed as transferable skill.

lines: I stay outside its range and move past the bend before it commits to a new anchor point.
The corridor is behind me. The organism never found a wall to fire from.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Organism remains active; threat preserved but not triggered.
Corridor traversed without engagement cost.

operator_cellar_scar_navigation.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar_scar_navigation.line_1: The wall here has the same hole spacing. My hands find the pattern before I think to look for it.
operator_cellar_scar_navigation.line_2: I know which hole is third from the left without counting. The room is dark but the route is already in my body.

buttons.label: Stop and check what else is using it

lines: I move through the dark by touch. The spacing is exact. Whatever built these rooms used the same interval everywhere.
I come out the other side without slowing. The route is mine now.
Something else has been pressing these holes. The residue is fresh and it is not operator tissue.
There is another one in this wall. It has not finished learning the sequence yet — but it will.

operator_cellar_blood_trace_attention.speaker: Hymn
operator_cellar_blood_trace_attention.line_1: A low feeder in the next corridor has stopped with its snout to my blood.
operator_cellar_blood_trace_attention.line_2: It is not the cellar predator. It reads the floor before it reads me.

buttons.label: Pull back and let it pass

lines: I move fast and low. It lifts its head when I pass but I am already through its angle.
It does not follow. It goes back to the floor. I keep the route and the initiative.
I hold position until it moves on. It takes longer than I want and costs me the corridor window.
When it goes, it heads toward the cellar — it will find what I left on that wall.

amar_debt_collection.speaker: Hymn
amar_debt_collection.line_1: The receipt blister on my wrist pulses once. Amar steps out of a side membrane two rooms past the chapel. He is not threatening me. He is reminding me.
amar_debt_collection.line_2: He wants passage through a corridor I know and he wants it now. The blister will keep pulsing until I answer him.

buttons.label: Refuse and burn the blister off

lines: I tell him the corridor and the beat.
He nods and the blister goes cold and falls away from my wrist in a dry flake.
The debt is paid.
Amar walks the passage I gave him and does not look back.
The route remembers that I honored the exchange.
Later corridors with timed walls will read a half-beat earlier for me, as if the organism learned I can be trusted with its rhythm.
result_lines: I give him the beat and the corridor. The blister drops off clean. Debt settled, route intact, rivalry cooled by one honest exchange.
He walks the passage without looking back. I lose nothing I needed and keep the goodwill. The organism rewards the bargain.

lines: I press my thumbnail into the blister and drag. It tears and leaks something warm and sour. Amar feels it from wherever he is. He will not offer instruction again.
The debt is gone but so is the goodwill.
The route memory I have is partial now, the half I watched instead of learned, and Amar will remember that I burned the receipt rather than pay it.
result_lines: The blister tears. The debt dissolves into something sour and permanent. Amar will not extend another receipt.
I kept the corridor but forfeited the alliance. The route I hold is half a read — enough to injure me later.

referenced_by.source_label: Let him show me the beat

amar_resentment_return.speaker: Hymn
amar_resentment_return.line_1: Amar's saw scrapes the wall of the passage ahead. He is moving through the same corridor I need and he is not holding the beat open for me.
amar_resentment_return.line_2: He could share the timing. He is choosing not to. The wall cuts are already cycling and I have to decide whether to force the crossing or find another way through.

buttons.label: Force the crossing on my own read

lines: I go on my own count.
The wall cut catches my shoulder on the close and I feel the edge before I clear it.
I make it through.
Amar is already past the next seam and does not turn.
The partial read was enough but it cost me.
The route memory firms up a little from the pain of getting it wrong first.
I know the beat better now because I bled for it instead of watching for it.
result_lines: My shoulder catches the close. I clear the seam bleeding. The injury writes the correct count into my body where the watch never did.
Amar does not turn. The rivalry holds its shape. I paid the crossing in wound-debt instead of asking — that choice is now part of the route.

lines: I say his name. He stops. He does not turn around but he stops. I tell him I watched him instead of asking and I know what that was.
He is quiet for three beats of the wall.
Then he steps aside and lets me see the crossing.
He does not offer the receipt blister again.
The resentment is still there but it has a different shape now, less like a weapon and more like a scar.
result_lines: I name what I did. He stops. Three beats of silence, then he steps aside — not forgiveness, but acknowledgment of the debt I named.
The resentment reshapes from active rivalry into old injury. He shows me the crossing. No blister offered. The bargain is smaller now but it holds.

referenced_by.source_label: Watch his feet and cross when he does

scar_map_clean_route_revision.speaker: Hymn
scar_map_clean_route_revision.line_1: A scar mite rides the back of my hand. It has been there since the junction. Its grain matches the seam I followed, and it is still reading.
scar_map_clean_route_revision.line_2: The mite carries a route packet. I can let it finish the read and send the packet forward, or I can scrape it off now and lose whatever the clean route was trying to tell me.

lines: The mite drops. A seam in the next wall opens a finger-width: route favor, paid forward by a junction I did not mark.
My signature is now in the infrastructure. I do not know who reads it next.
The mite curls against the wall and goes still. The route packet dies with it.
The seam ahead does not pulse. The junction will not remember I was careful.

scar_map_marked_branch_recognition.speaker: Hymn
scar_map_marked_branch_recognition.line_1: A receipt blister on the gate post pulses when I step close. It carries my mark from the junction, already read, already answered.
scar_map_marked_branch_recognition.line_2: The blister is offering something: a reduced toll, or a branch the gate usually keeps sealed. But accepting means confirming my signature to whoever set the blister.

buttons.label: Pass the gate without touching it

lines: The gate opens a sealed branch. My signature is confirmed at this checkpoint; the faction now knows I marked the junction and took the bargain.
The branch is real. The price is recognition I cannot take back.
I walk past without contact. The offer expires. The gate holds its standard setting.
My signature is unconfirmed here. The sealed branch stays closed.

biomass_larder_collection_feeder_arrives.speaker: Hymn
biomass_larder_collection_feeder_arrives.line_1: A feeder is pressed against the wall membrane ahead of me. It has a receipt blister on its back with my weight signature in the larder's resin-stamp. It is not moving fast. It is moving toward me.
biomass_larder_collection_feeder_arrives.line_2: The blister is addressed. The debt is specific. I can meet it, push through, or let it find me in a worse room.

lines: I press resin into the blister. It softens and goes dark. The feeder turns back into the wall without touching me.
The debt is closed. The route relaxes one degree behind me.
I push past. The blister drags across my arm and the resin-stamp transfers a partial mark onto my skin.
The debt is forwarded, not cleared. The next collection point will read the mark before I speak.

biomass_larder_route_favor_packet.speaker: Hymn
biomass_larder_route_favor_packet.line_1: A small packet is wedged into the junction wall at shoulder height. The larder's resin-stamp is on the outside. It is lighter than a full ration but the membrane is clean and there is no debt address on it.
biomass_larder_route_favor_packet.line_2: I can take it, leave it for the route, or press extra resin into the stamp to build the credit larger.

lines: The membrane opens cleanly. The food is smaller than a full ration but the larder's stamp on my hand is a paid mark, not a debt mark.
The route logs that I collected. This is what that looks like.
I leave the packet in the wall. The credit holds on the route's ledger without my name attached.
Someone else collects it. I walk on lighter than I could have been.

harbor_ledger_recognition.speaker: Hymn
harbor_ledger_recognition.line_1: The receipt blister on my wrist has split open. Inside it is a thin cord of dried resin, shaped like a passage key. A dock mouth in the wall ahead is already open before I reach it.
harbor_ledger_recognition.line_2: The harbor paid me back. I can take the open passage now or leave it and see if the ledger holds further in.

lines: I press through the open mouth. The passage inside is dry and short, cutting two rooms of wet corridor off my route.
The harbor ledger is settled. Whatever it logged about me, it spent it here.
I leave the open mouth behind. The blister on my wrist stays warm a little longer, then goes flat on its own.
The harbor closes the passage without complaint. The ledger entry dissolves. I do not know if it will remember me the next time.

contamination_surfaces.speaker: Hymn
contamination_surfaces.line_1: The tissue around my shin cuts has gone tight and hot. The fluid from the harbor is moving now, tracking up toward the knee in slow pulses I can feel from the inside.
contamination_surfaces.line_2: I can brace through it and let my body process the intrusion, or I can stop and press the heat out through the wound sites before it moves further.

lines: My body grinds against the intrusion the whole length of the corridor. By the next chamber the pulse has gone quiet and the fluid is spent.
The cuts are wider and the shin is sore, but the contamination is processed. The harbor fluid has nothing left to push.
I stop and press both palms flat against the hot tissue. The fluid comes out slow and dark through the wound sites. The tightness drops with it.
The contamination is out. The cuts are clean. I lost time but the harbor got nothing it could keep.

chapel_recognition_return.speaker: Hymn
chapel_recognition_return.line_1: A cord receipt blister is pressed to the corridor wall at shoulder height. The drain-cut residue pattern on it matches my knees.
chapel_recognition_return.line_2: Someone in the maintenance layer has flagged my completion. The blister is an offer or a summons. I cannot tell which without opening it.

lines: The blister opens against my palm: a route marker two junctions ahead, a grip-pattern stamp matching the chapel larvae. The maintenance layer knows my posture now.
The corridor ahead is unlocked. I am legible to something that controls access I did not know existed.
I leave the blister on the wall. The maintenance layer made its offer. I am not ready to be that readable.
The corridor ahead stays locked. I move on with my route memory and nothing the institution gave me.

chapel_repair_retaliation.speaker: Hymn
chapel_repair_retaliation.line_1: A repair animal moves along the baseboard ahead. It trails a receipt blister that carries the chapel's damage log. It has not seen me yet.
chapel_repair_retaliation.line_2: If it reaches the next junction, the log gets filed and the repair crew behind it gets a location. I have a few seconds.

buttons.label: Let it pass and move fast
Pull back and find another route

lines: I move before the animal reaches the junction. The log files behind me. The repair crew gets the chapel, not my direction.
Two corridors clear before the crew arrives. The damage is logged but the body that made it is already somewhere else.
I pull back. The animal files the log and the repair crew gets a direction. They are moving now.
The longer route costs time. The crew is between me and the direct path and they know the chapel damage is recent.

chapel_shaft_access.speaker: Hymn
chapel_shaft_access.line_1: The wall tissue ahead has the same thickness as the shaft wall in the chapel. Grip wear marks run along the baseboard at the same height.
chapel_shaft_access.line_2: The maintenance shaft continues here. The rite never mentioned this section because the ceremony stopped before the work did.

lines: The tissue gives at the same pressure point as the chapel wall. The shaft is dry, clear, forty body-lengths to a junction the main route never touches.
I have a path the institution does not know I know. The chapel route memory paid out here.
I stay on the main corridor. The shaft is in the wall behind me, noted, unused. I move with the route I can see.
The unlisted junction stays unlisted. I keep the option and keep moving.

plate_stride_recognition_followup.speaker: Hymn
plate_stride_recognition_followup.line_1: A counting cord stretches across the lane ahead, already set to my stride length. It did not come from this room. It came from the plates I walked two rooms back.
plate_stride_recognition_followup.line_2: The cord is slack enough to step over if I match the imprinted pace. If I break stride here, it snaps tight and the barbs on the wall get a reading.

buttons.label: Match the imprinted stride and step over
Break stride and take the snap

lines: I match the pace exactly. The cord stays slack. I step over clean and the corridor confirms the route.
The bone-lane accepts me as continuous with what it already counted. No new debt. Forward passage holds.
The cord snaps across my shin. Barbs bite and the wall registers the break — hunt pressure climbs one grade.
The wound is shallow but logged. I bought passage with injury and the corridor now knows I deviate.

dust_trace_predator_followup.speaker: Hymn
dust_trace_predator_followup.line_1: The dry scent I noticed two rooms back is closer now. Something is reading the dust record I left in the rib screen and following the gap forward.
dust_trace_predator_followup.line_2: I can hold position and let it close, or move fast and try to break the trace before it gets a body reading on me.

buttons.label: Move fast and break the trace

combat.preview: Immediate: first contact seized; hunt pressure rises.
lines: I hold and take first contact before it finishes reading me. The cost is paid in hunt pressure.
The thing that followed my dust record meets a body it did not expect to be awake.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Predator engaged at close range; holding position invites escalation.
Hymn seizes first contact, closing the predator's read before it completes.

retreat.preview: Immediate: trace broken; cache gap remains on record.
lines: I move before it closes. The scent loses direction and the trace goes cold behind me.
Hunt pressure drops. The cache gap stays in the corridor's record as an open cost.

pressure_axis_changes.reason: Trace broken before body reading completes; predator loses lock.
Cache gap remains legible in the corridor record; a future reader can still follow it.

larder_credit_return.speaker: Hymn
larder_credit_return.line_1: A ration pocket is wedged into the junction wall. My palm print is pressed into the seal. Someone sent this ahead of me.
larder_credit_return.line_2: The pocket is full. The seal opens clean under my hand. The organism paid me back.

lines: The ration is dense and warm. I eat it moving. The palm print dissolves off the seal behind me.
The debt closes. Nothing carries forward.
I leave the pocket in the wall. The palm print stays pressed into the seal. Someone else will find it or it will wait.
The debt stays open. I walk away from what I was owed.

larder_debt_collector.speaker: Hymn
larder_debt_collector.line_1: Something has been in this corridor before me. The walls are marked at shoulder height, scored in a pattern I do not recognize. The scoring is fresh.
larder_debt_collector.line_2: It rounds the bend ahead of me and stops. Bigger than the collector. A receipt blister covers its entire forearm from wrist to elbow. It is reading my weight from ten feet away.

buttons.label: Break the corridor pattern and run

lines: It charges low. I take the hit on my shoulder and drive my elbow into the blister arm. The blister cracks. It pulls back, reading the damage.
It does not press the broken blister to anything. It retreats down the corridor and does not come back.
I go sideways through the wall membrane before it can close the distance. The scoring pattern ends at the breach.
I hear it stop at the hole I made. It does not follow. Whatever it was carrying goes somewhere else instead of into me.

larder_restraint_signal.speaker: Hymn
larder_restraint_signal.line_1: A collector steps out of a side passage. Smaller than the one at the larder. No receipt blister. She is holding a ration pocket toward me with both hands.
larder_restraint_signal.line_2: She does not speak. The pocket is sealed with a different mark than the larder's. She is watching my hands, not my face.

lines: I take it. She nods once and steps back into the passage. The ration is clean and offered without a blister.
The hunger breaks. She read my hands, judged the debt still open, and pushed the ration through before refusal could form.
I walk past her. She lowers the pocket and holds still until I am gone. The hunger stays.
The passage closes behind her. The offer will not repeat in this corridor.

solt_debt_return.speaker: Hymn
solt_debt_return.line_1: The scar mite on the wall is carrying a cord-fragment from Solt's feeder. It is moving toward a seam I need to cross.
solt_debt_return.line_2: If the mite reaches the seam it will anchor the fragment and finish the print Solt started. I have one move before it gets there.

lines: The cord-fragment crumbles in my fist. The seam ahead stays dark when I cross. Nothing in the junction flags my passage.
Solt's debt anchor is gone. The seam owes me nothing and knows nothing.
The fragment locks into the seam. Solt's cord now runs through this junction. The debt is anchored and active.
The route ahead opens a half-second early. Solt already paid it to expect me.

chapel_drift_receipt.speaker: Hymn
chapel_drift_receipt.line_1: Two rooms out, my hands are still shaped to the larvae's grip. A tool-rest in this wall is open at exactly that width. It is holding something the sequence displaced.
chapel_drift_receipt.line_2: If I take it, I am finishing what the chapel started. If I leave it, the grip fades on its own—but slower than I want.

buttons.label: Pull my hands back and let the grip fade

lines: The resin cord is warm and dense in my palms. My hands close around it without deciding to.
The chapel's sequence is complete. My body knows it finished something.
I pull back. The grip lingers two more corridors, then empties out of my hands like water.
The channel it left is not painful. It is just there now, inside the muscle.

bone_corridor_keeper_report.speaker: Hymn
bone_corridor_keeper_report.line_1: A counting cord is stretched across the threshold at chest height. It is taut and pale and was not here before. A second keeper is on the far side, one hand already on the next gate, watching the cord.
bone_corridor_keeper_report.line_2: The cord is a report. The first keeper sent my description forward. The second one knows I cut the first off a gate and it has already decided how much gate pressure to use.

buttons.label: Cut the cord and move fast
Step under the cord without touching it

lines: I cut the cord and move before the keeper can reset. It commits to the wrong angle. I am already inside its reach.
The gate swings open when the keeper loses contact. I am through before it recovers.
I go low and slow under the cord. The keeper on the far side watches it stay still and does not move.
I reach the gate and push it open with one hand. The keeper lets me through without a word.

drowned_toll_harbor_collector_return.speaker: Hymn
drowned_toll_harbor_collector_return.line_1: The pale shape in the fluid ahead is not a current. It has the same wide shoulders, the same locked grip on the rib bone. The same hand pressed to the place I hit. It followed the route.
drowned_toll_harbor_collector_return.line_2: It is not blocking the exit this time. It is between me and the wall, and the fluid around it is moving toward my legs.

buttons.label: Back out of the fluid fast

lines: I drop low before the grip closes and take the blow on my shoulder.
The collector is slower than before.
I pin it against the rib until it stops.
The fluid goes still. The collector holds position but does not follow me to the exit. My shoulder will carry this room.
I back out before the fluid reaches my cuts. The collector does not cross the rib line. It watches me leave and stays.
The route is closed. The collector has filed my direction into the fluid and I am not getting that back.

warden_residue_patrol_read.speaker: Hymn
warden_residue_patrol_read.line_1: A patrol organism in the corridor ahead has stopped moving. It is reading the wet mark on my palm. The mark from the chapel drain.
warden_residue_patrol_read.line_2: It is not attacking. It is deciding. The way it holds its grip arms says it has seen this mark before and knows what made it.

buttons.label: Hold still and let it finish reading
Break its read before it decides

lines: The read closes. Its grip arms lower and it steps aside without welcome.
The mark paid passage. I do not yet know the full cost of that debt.
I pull back before it finishes. The read stays open, flagged and unresolved.
Something deeper in the route now knows an unread body broke contact.

amber_corridor_silt_return_paid.speaker: Hymn
amber_corridor_silt_return_paid.line_1: The receipt blister on the wall is warm and pressed flat, the same resin as Silt's plaque. It has my heat in it. He filed me.
amber_corridor_silt_return_paid.line_2: There is a second pulse inside it, slower than the first. He has already added the next corridor to my account.

buttons.label: Pull the blister off the wall

lines: Resin runs cold across my knuckles. The account closes with a soft crack.
Silt's network registers a gap. The goodwill I paid for is gone with the blister.
The pulse ticks once as I pass. He is extending the ledger forward.
I am paying for the privilege of being predictable.

amber_corridor_silt_return_spoiled.speaker: Hymn
amber_corridor_silt_return_spoiled.line_1: The wall patch near the junction is fresh resin over a clean cut. Someone pulled something out of it recently and sealed it fast.
amber_corridor_silt_return_spoiled.line_2: The smell is Silt's. He was here after me. He left something, or he took something, and I cannot tell which without opening it.

buttons.label: Open the patch and find out

lines: A thin slab sits inside, pressed flat against the resin. He kept a duplicate.
The debt is still live. He was never relying on the one I burned.
I mark the patch and leave it sealed. Whatever he put there stays there.
He plans ahead. He knows I know this corridor.

amber_corridor_silt_return_read.speaker: Hymn
amber_corridor_silt_return_read.line_1: Silt's cord is looped around the anchor blister near the junction. It is a specific knot. It means he was here and he wants me to know it.
amber_corridor_silt_return_read.line_2: The cord has a small bead organ pressed into one end. It is still warm. It is recording.

buttons.label: Pull the cord down and take the organ

lines: I say my name into the organ. It pulses once. Silt has my voice now — I gave it freely, which is its own kind of claim.
The rivalry sharpens. He knows I am not running. That changes what he will offer next.
The cord comes free and the organ goes cold. Silt's post is gone. He will know I took it — and that I knew exactly what it was.
Hunt pressure rises. He will not send another organ. He will come himself.

referenced_by.source_label: Read the plaque before he finishes his pitch

spiked_red_corridor_broken_tip_return.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor_broken_tip_return.line_1: The scar mite drops a sealed blister at my feet. Inside it is a small spine tip, the one it pulled from my shoulder in the red corridor. The tip is still warm.
spiked_red_corridor_broken_tip_return.line_2: Something in this organism sent the mite. The tip is an address. Someone or something in the next passage is expecting a body that knows how to break a row from the inside.

buttons.label: Take the tip and follow the address
Leave the blister and move on

lines: The tip is sharp in my palm. The mite climbs back to my shoulder and goes still.
Whatever is ahead already knows I am coming.
I leave the blister on the floor. The mite watches me go.
The address expires. Whatever was waiting stops waiting.

spiked_red_corridor_wound_debt_return.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor_wound_debt_return.line_1: The repair animal stops in front of me and will not move. It is reading the puncture geometry on my forearm. Two entry points, parallel, spine-width apart.
spiked_red_corridor_wound_debt_return.line_2: It knows where I got these. It is deciding whether to close them or leave them as a record. I can let it choose or I can push past it and keep the debt.

buttons.label: Let the repair animal close the wounds
Push past it and keep moving

lines: Two passes and the punctures are sealed. A faint ridge marks where the geometry was read and answered.
The wound debt clears. This organism knows what I came through.
I push past it. The punctures stay open and the repair animal does not follow.
The debt holds. I carry the geometry forward.

spiked_red_corridor_patience_return.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor_patience_return.line_1: The lens film is still on the wall. A cord runs from it into the ceiling tissue. Something at the other end has been watching since I held still.
spiked_red_corridor_patience_return.line_2: The cord is taut. Whatever is watching is close. I can follow it or cut it.

buttons.label: Follow the cord toward the watcher
Cut the cord and break the attention

lines: The cord pulls taut as I move. Something at the far end registers my approach and does not retreat.
I cut the cord at the wall. The lens film goes dark. The ceiling tissue contracts and seals the channel. The quiet that follows has a shape to it.

cord_signal_followup.speaker: Hymn
cord_signal_followup.line_1: A black cord runs along the ceiling here. It is doing something different depending on what I did in the red chamber.
cord_signal_followup.line_2: The cord is still active. I can read it, cut it, or leave it and see what it feeds downstream.

buttons.label: Read the cord's tension before moving on
Cut the cord and end the signal

lines: The cord's rhythm matches my sternum exactly. The organism has already decided what I am.
I know what it thinks. That is worth something before I move.
The cord splits and the rhythm stops. The receipt blister on the far seam drops and cracks open.
Downstream gets silence. The route ahead has no read on me now.
I leave the cord and move through. It keeps doing what it was doing.
Whatever is downstream already has its read on me.

egg_corridor_followup_sleeve_marker.speaker: Hymn
egg_corridor_followup_sleeve_marker.line_1: The resin ring on my sleeve has hardened into a faint raised edge. In the next corridor a wall feeder opens toward me before I reach it. It is reading the ring, not my heat.
egg_corridor_followup_sleeve_marker.line_2: I can scrape the ring off against the wall and lose the recognition. Or I can leave it and see what else opens.

buttons.label: Scrape the ring off on the wall edge

lines: The ring flakes off in two passes. The feeder closes flush.
The corridor goes neutral. Nothing opens ahead of me now.
The feeder stays open as I pass. Something behind the membrane shifts toward my sleeve.
Not hostile. It is curious and now it knows my shape.

egg_corridor_followup_cold_record.speaker: Hymn
egg_corridor_followup_cold_record.line_1: The thing in the corridor ahead has been still since I entered. Now it turns. It has my heat shape mapped but no scent to confirm. It is deciding whether I am prey or passage.
egg_corridor_followup_cold_record.line_2: If I give it my breath now it will finish the record and either stand down or commit. If I hold again I stay unknown and it stays uncertain.

buttons.label: Exhale slow and let it read me
Hold breath and push past while it hesitates

lines: It reads my breath and its posture drops. Not friendly — neutral.
It steps aside. The corridor is mine while it watches.
I move before it decides. It turns to follow for three steps, then stops.
It still has no smell on me. The gap holds.

egg_corridor_followup_full_record.speaker: Hymn
egg_corridor_followup_full_record.line_1: The repair animal is still behind me. It has been following at the same distance for two corridors. It stops when I stop. It carries a small cord of dried membrane looped around one forelimb.
egg_corridor_followup_full_record.line_2: The cord matches the shell material from the brood lane. It is not a threat. It is a marker. Something in the brood-line sent it after me.

buttons.label: Let it approach and read the cord
Drive it off and keep the distance clean

lines: The cord unspools into a membrane map. I am flagged as known passage through this sac family's nodes.
The repair animal drops the cord at my feet and leaves without looking back.
It backs three steps and holds. When I move again it does not follow.
The cord stays on its forelimb. The offer is closed and the lane stays mine.

healing_pool_patient_mark_followup.speaker: Hymn
healing_pool_patient_mark_followup.line_1: A repair-scale fragment is still on my wrist. It is warm and flat and has not detached in two rooms. A custodian-class shape at the far end of this corridor has its fans open and is not moving toward me.
healing_pool_patient_mark_followup.line_2: The scale is a pass or a leash. I do not know which yet. The shape at the end of the corridor is waiting.

lines: The custodian-class shape steps aside as I pass. Its fans brush the scale fragment on my wrist and close.
Patient classification holds. The route remembers.
The fragment pulls free with a thin strip of skin. The custodian's fans snap wide the instant it detaches.
The pass is gone. The shape does not advance but it is no longer standing aside.

healing_pool_parasite_mark_followup.speaker: Hymn
healing_pool_parasite_mark_followup.line_1: Something flat and scale-textured has been moving along the back of my knee for two rooms. It is not painful. It is reading.
healing_pool_parasite_mark_followup.line_2: A body I do not recognize is standing at the corridor junction ahead. One arm is trailing and pale. It is watching me the way the custodian watched me.

buttons.label: Hold position and let it approach

lines: It stops two steps from me. The pale arm lifts, showing the thread-mass still clinging inside its elbow where I displaced it.
It turns and walks. The scale-reader drops from my knee. The debt is paid but the rival is ahead and knows my pace.
I clear the junction before it closes the gap. The scale-reader tightens once against my knee and goes still.
The mark is still active. The next custodian room will already know.

healing_pool_unresolved_followup.speaker: Hymn
healing_pool_unresolved_followup.line_1: The wound has been pulling at the edge of my attention for three rooms. The corridor ahead smells like the pool: sterile, threaded, faintly alive.
healing_pool_unresolved_followup.line_2: A repair-animal the size of my fist is sitting in the middle of the passage. It is not blocking me. It is offering.

lines: The repair-animal closes the wound in four quick passes. The closure holds. Debt to the custodian drops one grade.
It folds its fan and steps aside. I owe less than I did. The corridor ahead is open.
I shoulder past it. The wound stays open. The repair-animal does not follow — its offer is spent.
The custodian gets no new data. Whatever ruling it was building, it builds without me.

referenced_by.source_label: Back away before it finishes reading

spiked_red_corridor_watcher_followup.speaker: Hymn
spiked_red_corridor_watcher_followup.line_1: The cord ends at a valve chamber no wider than my shoulders. A route keeper is braced across the far wall, limbs locked into tissue on both sides, holding the passage closed.
spiked_red_corridor_watcher_followup.line_2: A sealed resource packet is wedged under one limb, pressed against the wall. The keeper is not feeding. It has been waiting here. It does not move.

buttons.label: Accept the toll and take the packet
Drive through the keeper and take the passage

lines: I reach past the keeper and take the packet. Its limbs tighten once around the passage walls as my arm crosses, then release.
The packet is dense and warm. The keeper does not follow me out.
I hit the keeper before it can reset its grip. It is strong locked but slow to a direct strike. I break one limb free and drive it back.
The packet drops and splits, partially intact. The keeper retreats into a side duct. It will not wait for me again.
I hold at the entrance and read without stepping in. The keeper's grip is defensive. The packet placement is deliberate.
A second cord runs from its dorsal plate into the ceiling, thinner, still live.
Something further in is watching through the keeper. I back out before my hesitation reads as an answer.
